items.q: Which of the following is one of the four values of the Agile Manifesto?

o.A: Detailed up-front planning over incremental delivery
o.B: Specialized roles over shared responsibility
o.C: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools
o.D: Formal sign-off over continuous feedback

items.exEn: The four values are: individuals and interactions, working software, customer collaboration, and responding to change.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ إحدى القيم الأربع في الـ Agile Manifesto؟
items.exAr: القيم الأربع هي: الأفراد والتفاعلات، والبرمجية العاملة، والتعاون مع العميل، والاستجابة للتغيير.

items.q: Which pair correctly expresses an Agile Manifesto value?

o.A: Comprehensive documentation over working software
o.B: Contract negotiation over customer collaboration
o.C: Following a plan over responding to change
o.D: Working software over comprehensive documentation

items.exEn: Each value places the left-hand item above the right-hand one, never the reverse.
items.qAr: أي زوج يعبّر بشكل صحيح عن إحدى قيم الـ Agile Manifesto؟
items.exAr: كل قيمة تضع العنصر على اليسار فوق العنصر على اليمين، وليس العكس.

items.q: What does the word 'over' mean in the Agile Manifesto values?

o.A: The items on the right are forbidden in Agile projects
o.B: The items on the right still have value, but the items on the left are valued more
o.C: The items on the right apply only to regulated industries
o.D: The items on the left replace the items on the right entirely

items.exEn: The Manifesto explicitly states that while there is value in the items on the right, the items on the left are valued more.
items.qAr: ماذا تعني كلمة «over» في قيم الـ Agile Manifesto؟
items.exAr: ينص الـ Manifesto صراحةً على أن للعناصر على اليمين قيمة، لكن العناصر على اليسار ذات قيمة أكبر.

items.q: What does the whole-team approach mean in an Agile project?

o.A: Every team member must be able to perform every task equally well
o.B: The tester alone is accountable for the quality of the release
o.C: Everyone on the team, with their different skills, is responsible for product quality
o.D: The team is managed directly by the customer during the iteration

items.exEn: Quality is a shared responsibility of business representatives, developers and testers working together.
items.qAr: ماذا يعني نهج الفريق الكامل (whole-team approach) في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: الجودة مسؤولية مشتركة بين ممثلي الأعمال والمطوّرين والمختبِرين معاً.

items.q: Which of the following is a benefit of the whole-team approach?

o.A: It removes the need for any test documentation
o.B: Knowledge and skills are shared, and testers contribute from the very beginning
o.C: It guarantees that no defects reach the customer
o.D: It allows each role to work independently of the others

items.exEn: Bringing the different perspectives together early improves communication and catches misunderstandings sooner.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ فائدة لنهج الفريق الكامل؟
items.exAr: جمع المنظورات المختلفة مبكراً يحسّن التواصل ويكشف سوء الفهم في وقت أبكر.

items.q: Why is early and frequent feedback important in Agile projects?

o.A: It allows the team to skip the retrospective meeting
o.B: It removes the need to prioritize the backlog
o.C: It helps the team find misunderstandings and defects while they are still cheap to correct
o.D: It shifts responsibility for quality to the customer

items.exEn: Frequent feedback exposes wrong assumptions early and keeps the product aligned with real business needs.
items.qAr: لماذا تُعدّ التغذية الراجعة المبكرة والمتكررة مهمة في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: التغذية الراجعة المتكررة تكشف الافتراضات الخاطئة مبكراً وتُبقي المنتج متوافقاً مع احتياجات الأعمال الحقيقية.

items.q: Which of the following is a recognized benefit of the team sitting together (co-location)?

o.A: It removes the need for a product backlog
o.B: Faster, richer communication that reduces the need for formal handovers
o.C: It guarantees a higher team velocity every iteration
o.D: It makes automated regression testing unnecessary

items.exEn: Face-to-face conversation is the most efficient way of conveying information within a development team.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ فائدة معروفة لجلوس الفريق معاً (co-location)؟
items.exAr: الحوار المباشر وجهاً لوجه هو أكفأ وسيلة لنقل المعلومات داخل فريق التطوير.

items.q: Which of the following is one of the values of Extreme Programming (XP)?

o.A: Velocity
o.B: Refactoring
o.C: Timeboxing
o.D: Courage

items.exEn: XP is based on five values: communication, simplicity, feedback, courage and respect. Refactoring and timeboxing are practices, not values.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ إحدى قيم الـ Extreme Programming (XP)؟
items.exAr: يقوم الـ XP على خمس قيم: التواصل والبساطة والتغذية الراجعة والشجاعة والاحترام. أما الـ refactoring والـ timeboxing فهما ممارسات لا قيم.

items.q: Which of the following is an XP practice?

o.A: Sprint review
o.B: Work-in-progress limits
o.C: Pair programming
o.D: Product backlog refinement

items.exEn: Pair programming, collective ownership, sustainable pace, test-first development and continuous integration are XP practices.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ ممارسة من ممارسات الـ XP؟
items.exAr: الـ pair programming والملكية الجماعية والوتيرة المستدامة والتطوير المبدوء بالاختبار والتكامل المستمر كلها ممارسات XP.

items.q: In Scrum, what is the product backlog?

o.A: The fixed list of tasks the team committed to for the current sprint
o.B: The list of defects found during the last release
o.C: A prioritized list of everything that might be needed in the product, maintained by the product owner
o.D: The list of automated tests maintained by the testers

items.exEn: The product backlog is ordered by business value and continuously refined; the sprint backlog is the subset selected for one sprint.
items.qAr: في الـ Scrum، ما المقصود بالـ product backlog؟
items.exAr: يُرتَّب الـ product backlog حسب قيمة الأعمال ويُحدَّث باستمرار، بينما الـ sprint backlog هو الجزء المختار لـ sprint واحد.

items.q: Who is responsible for prioritizing the product backlog in Scrum?

o.A: The product owner
o.B: The scrum master
o.C: The test manager
o.D: The development team as a whole

items.exEn: The product owner represents the customer, owns the backlog and decides the order of the items.
items.qAr: من المسؤول عن ترتيب أولويات الـ product backlog في الـ Scrum؟
items.exAr: يمثّل الـ product owner العميل، ويملك الـ backlog ويقرر ترتيب عناصره.

items.q: What is the primary responsibility of the scrum master?

o.A: Coaching the team on the process and removing the impediments that block its progress
o.B: Assigning daily tasks to each developer and tester
o.C: Deciding which user stories enter the next sprint
o.D: Approving the release on behalf of the business

items.exEn: The scrum master serves the team and protects the process; the product owner decides content, and the team decides how to build it.
items.qAr: ما المسؤولية الأساسية للـ scrum master؟
items.exAr: يخدم الـ scrum master الفريق ويحمي العملية، بينما يقرر الـ product owner المحتوى ويقرر الفريق كيفية التنفيذ.

items.q: What does timeboxing mean in the context of Scrum?

o.A: The scope of the sprint is fixed but its end date can move
o.B: Testing activities are limited to the last two days of the sprint
o.C: Iterations and meetings have a fixed maximum duration that does not change
o.D: Each task is allocated exactly the same amount of time

items.exEn: The sprint length is fixed; if work cannot be completed, scope is adjusted rather than the end date.
items.qAr: ماذا يعني الـ timeboxing في سياق الـ Scrum؟
items.exAr: طول الـ sprint ثابت، وإذا تعذّر إنجاز العمل يُعدَّل النطاق لا تاريخ الانتهاء.

items.q: What is the purpose of the definition of done?

o.A: To define the criteria a user story must meet before it enters the sprint
o.B: To list the acceptance criteria of one specific user story
o.C: To define the shared criteria that a backlog item must satisfy before it is considered complete
o.D: To document the exit criteria of the release test phase only

items.exEn: The definition of done applies to all items and usually includes testing, review and documentation criteria agreed by the whole team.
items.qAr: ما الهدف من الـ definition of done؟
items.exAr: ينطبق الـ definition of done على جميع العناصر، ويشمل عادةً معايير الاختبار والمراجعة والتوثيق المتفق عليها من الفريق كله.

items.q: What is meant by a potentially releasable increment at the end of a sprint?

o.A: A build that still requires a separate hardening phase before it can be tested
o.B: Working, tested functionality that could be delivered to the customer if the business decides to
o.C: A prototype used only to gather feedback from stakeholders
o.D: A release that must be deployed to production at the end of every sprint

items.exEn: The increment must be complete and tested; whether to actually release it is a business decision.
items.qAr: ماذا يُقصد بالـ increment القابل للإصدار في نهاية الـ sprint؟
items.exAr: يجب أن يكون الـ increment مكتملاً ومختبَراً، أما قرار إصداره فعلياً فهو قرار يخص الأعمال.

items.q: What is the purpose of a work-in-progress (WIP) limit in Kanban?

o.A: To limit the number of items in each state so bottlenecks become visible and flow improves
o.B: To limit the number of user stories the product owner may add to the backlog
o.C: To limit the maximum duration of each iteration
o.D: To limit the number of defects the team may report per day

items.exEn: Constraining work in progress exposes bottlenecks and shortens lead time instead of hiding queues.
items.qAr: ما الهدف من حد العمل قيد التنفيذ (WIP limit) في الـ Kanban؟
items.exAr: تقييد العمل قيد التنفيذ يكشف الاختناقات ويقصّر زمن الإنجاز بدل إخفاء الطوابير.

items.q: Which statement about Kanban compared with Scrum is correct?

o.A: Kanban requires strictly two-week iterations
o.B: Kanban forbids the use of a visual board
o.C: Kanban requires a product owner role to be defined
o.D: Kanban does not require timeboxed iterations; items may be released individually as they are finished

items.exEn: In Kanban the flow is continuous; timeboxing is optional, and delivery can happen item by item.
items.qAr: أي عبارة حول الـ Kanban مقارنةً بالـ Scrum صحيحة؟
items.exAr: في الـ Kanban يكون التدفق مستمراً، والـ timeboxing اختياري، ويمكن التسليم عنصراً بعنصر.

items.q: What are the three C's of a user story?

o.A: Customer, contract and commitment
o.B: Card, conversation and confirmation
o.C: Code, compile and commit
o.D: Clarity, consistency and completeness

items.exEn: The card records the intent, the conversation builds shared understanding, and the confirmation is the acceptance criteria.
items.qAr: ما المقصود بالـ three C's في الـ user story؟
items.exAr: تسجّل الـ card النية، ويبني الـ conversation فهماً مشتركاً، أما الـ confirmation فهي معايير القبول.

items.q: In the INVEST model for good user stories, what does the letter 'T' stand for?

o.A: Testable
o.B: Traceable
o.C: Timeboxed
o.D: Technical

items.exEn: INVEST stands for Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small and Testable.
items.qAr: في نموذج INVEST لالـ user stories الجيدة، إلى ماذا يشير حرف الـ T؟
items.exAr: يرمز INVEST إلى: مستقلة، وقابلة للتفاوض، وذات قيمة، وقابلة للتقدير، وصغيرة، وقابلة للاختبار.

items.q: What is the main contribution of the tester during collaborative user story writing?

o.A: Writing the technical design of the story
o.B: Asking questions that expose missing or ambiguous behavior and making the acceptance criteria testable
o.C: Deciding the business priority of the story
o.D: Estimating the story on behalf of the developers

items.exEn: The tester's unique perspective surfaces omissions, alternative paths and non-functional expectations before coding starts.
items.qAr: ما الإسهام الرئيسي للمختبِر أثناء كتابة الـ user stories بشكل تعاوني؟
items.exAr: منظور المختبِر يكشف الحالات المفقودة والمسارات البديلة والتوقعات غير الوظيفية قبل بدء البرمجة.

items.q: What is the purpose of a retrospective?

o.A: To demonstrate the completed increment to the stakeholders
o.B: To review what went well, what did not, and agree on improvements for the next iteration
o.C: To re-estimate the remaining items in the product backlog
o.D: To evaluate the individual performance of each team member

items.exEn: Retrospectives target process improvement; the sprint review is where the increment is demonstrated.
items.qAr: ما الهدف من اجتماع الـ retrospective؟
items.exAr: تستهدف الـ retrospectives تحسين العملية، أما عرض الـ increment فيتم في الـ sprint review.

items.q: Which activity is typically part of an automated continuous integration build?

o.A: Compiling the code, running static analysis and executing the automated unit tests
o.B: Running the full manual regression suite
o.C: Holding the sprint review with stakeholders
o.D: Re-prioritizing the product backlog

items.exEn: A CI build typically compiles, runs static analysis, runs automated tests and deploys to a test environment.
items.qAr: أي نشاط يُعدّ عادةً جزءاً من عملية البناء الآلي في التكامل المستمر؟
items.exAr: تقوم عملية الـ CI عادةً بالبناء وتشغيل التحليل الساكن وتنفيذ الاختبارات المؤتمتة والنشر على بيئة اختبار.

items.q: Which of the following is a recognized cost or risk of continuous integration?

o.A: Defects are detected later in the lifecycle
o.B: Introducing and maintaining the CI tools and the automated tests requires significant effort
o.C: The executable software becomes available less frequently
o.D: Manual regression testing effort always increases

items.exEn: CI brings clear benefits, but the tooling, the automated tests and their maintenance are a real ongoing investment.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ كلفة أو خطراً معروفاً للتكامل المستمر؟
items.exAr: للـ CI فوائد واضحة، لكن الأدوات والاختبارات المؤتمتة وصيانتها تمثّل استثماراً مستمراً حقيقياً.

items.q: What is the difference between release planning and iteration planning?

o.A: Release planning is done by the testers, while iteration planning is done by the developers
o.B: Release planning looks ahead to the delivery of a release, while iteration planning covers the scope of a single iteration
o.C: Release planning happens only once at the start of the project and is never revisited
o.D: Iteration planning defines the product backlog, while release planning defines the iteration backlog Processes

items.exEn: Release planning sets the bigger picture and is revisited as the project progresses; iteration planning details one iteration.
items.qAr: ما الفرق بين تخطيط الإصدار (release planning) وتخطيط التكرار (iteration planning)؟
items.exAr: يضع تخطيط الإصدار الصورة الأوسع ويُراجَع مع تقدّم المشروع، بينما يفصّل تخطيط التكرار عمل تكرار واحد.

items.q: What does the tester contribute during release planning?

o.A: Defining testable user stories and acceptance criteria, participating in risk analysis and estimating the test effort
o.B: Writing the automated unit tests for the first iteration
o.C: Deciding the business priority of each epic
o.D: Approving the architecture of the solution

items.exEn: In release planning the tester makes stories testable, contributes to quality risk analysis and plans the testing for the release.
items.qAr: ما الذي يساهم به المختبِر أثناء تخطيط الإصدار (release planning)؟
items.exAr: في تخطيط الإصدار يجعل المختبِر القصص قابلة للاختبار ويشارك في تحليل مخاطر الجودة ويخطط لاختبار الإصدار.

items.q: What does the tester contribute during iteration planning?

o.A: Approving the release date with the stakeholders
o.B: Writing the production code for the highest-priority story
o.C: Deciding which stories the product owner should drop
o.D: Detailed risk analysis of the user stories, assessing testability, breaking stories into testing tasks and estimating them

items.exEn: Iteration planning is where testing tasks are identified and estimated together with the rest of the team.
items.qAr: ما الذي يساهم به المختبِر أثناء تخطيط التكرار (iteration planning)؟
items.exAr: في تخطيط التكرار تُحدَّد مهام الاختبار وتُقدَّر مع باقي مهام الفريق.

items.q: How do testing and development activities relate to each other in an Agile project?

o.A: Testing forms a separate phase that starts once all development is finished
o.B: Testing is performed only in a dedicated hardening iteration before release
o.C: They are interwoven: testing happens continuously throughout the iteration, often starting before the code is written
o.D: Testing is limited to acceptance testing performed by the customer

items.exEn: In Agile, testing is a continuous activity rather than a phase, and test-first practices start it before coding.
items.qAr: ما العلاقة بين أنشطة الاختبار وأنشطة التطوير في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: في Agile يكون الاختبار نشاطاً مستمراً لا مرحلة، وممارسات test-first تبدأه قبل كتابة الكود.

items.q: Which of the following is a business-oriented work product in an Agile project?

o.A: The automated unit test suite
o.B: User stories together with their acceptance criteria
o.C: The continuous integration build script
o.D: The database migration script

items.exEn: Business-oriented work products describe what is needed and why: user stories, acceptance criteria and the backlog.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ مخرَج عمل موجَّهاً للأعمال في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: تصف المخرجات الموجَّهة للأعمال ما هو مطلوب ولماذا: الـ user stories ومعايير القبول والـ backlog.

items.q: Which of the following is a test work product in an Agile project?

o.A: Test charters, automated test cases, test results and defect reports
o.B: The product backlog maintained by the product owner
o.C: The source code of the delivered feature
o.D: The deployment pipeline configuration

items.exEn: Testware is owned by the team and, like code, must be version-controlled and maintained.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ مخرَج اختبار في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: مخرجات الاختبار ملك للفريق، ويجب إدارتها في نظام إصدارات وصيانتها تماماً كالكود.

items.q: How are test levels usually organized in an Agile project?

o.A: Only acceptance testing is performed, because the other levels are covered by the developers
o.B: The levels overlap within each iteration, with unit, integration, system and acceptance testing all taking place
o.C: Each level is executed in its own dedicated iteration
o.D: Only unit testing is performed during the iterations

items.exEn: All test levels still exist; they are compressed into the iteration rather than executed sequentially across phases.
items.qAr: كيف تُنظَّم مستويات الاختبار عادةً في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: تبقى جميع مستويات الاختبار قائمة، لكنها تنضغط داخل التكرار بدل تنفيذها تتابعياً عبر مراحل.

items.q: What is the difference between feature verification and feature validation?

o.A: Verification is performed by the customer, while validation is performed by the developers
o.B: Verification is always manual, while validation is always automated
o.C: Verification applies to non-functional testing only
o.D: Verification checks the feature against its acceptance criteria, while validation checks that it meets the real user need

items.exEn: Automated tests typically verify the criteria; exploratory and user feedback validate that the right product was built.
items.qAr: ما الفرق بين الـ feature verification والـ feature validation؟
items.exAr: تتحقق الاختبارات المؤتمتة عادةً من المعايير، بينما يؤكد الاختبار الاستكشافي وملاحظات المستخدم أننا بنينا المنتج الصحيح.

items.q: Why is configuration management particularly important for testing in Agile projects?

o.A: Frequent builds require that every test, test data set and result can be tied to a specific version of the software
o.B: It removes the need to maintain automated tests
o.C: It allows testers to work without access to the source repository
o.D: It replaces the need for a definition of done

items.exEn: With builds produced continuously, results are only meaningful if the exact version under test is known.
items.qAr: لماذا تُعدّ إدارة التكوين مهمة بشكل خاص للاختبار في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: مع إنتاج نسخ باستمرار، لا تكون النتائج ذات معنى إلا إذا عُرف الإصدار الذي جرى اختباره بدقة.

items.q: Which organizational option describes testers who are fully embedded in the Agile team?

o.A: The testers belong to a separate team and report defects at the end of each release
o.B: The testers are external consultants engaged only for acceptance testing
o.C: The testers work only on test automation and never on manual testing
o.D: The testers are part of the development team and participate in all team activities

items.exEn: Embedded testers gain deep product knowledge and fast communication, but may gradually lose independence of judgement.
items.qAr: أي خيار تنظيمي يصف المختبِرين المدمجين بالكامل في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: المختبِر المدمج يكتسب معرفة عميقة بالمنتج وتواصلاً سريعاً، لكنه قد يفقد تدريجياً استقلالية الحكم.

items.q: What is a potential drawback of testers being permanently embedded in one Agile team?

o.A: They cannot participate in the daily stand-up meeting
o.B: Over time they may lose objectivity and start to share the same assumptions as the rest of the team
o.C: They are unable to access the test environment
o.D: They must report to the product owner instead of the team

items.exEn: Independence is a spectrum: closeness brings speed and context but can blunt critical distance.
items.qAr: ما السلبية المحتملة لبقاء المختبِر مدمجاً بشكل دائم في فريق Agile واحد؟
items.exAr: الاستقلالية درجات: القرب يمنح السرعة والسياق، لكنه قد يُضعف المسافة النقدية.

items.q: What is the benefit of using an independent test team in an Agile organization?

o.A: It removes the need for testing inside the Agile teams
o.B: It guarantees that no defects reach production
o.C: It brings a fresh, unbiased perspective, especially for specialized testing such as performance or security
o.D: It shortens the iteration length automatically

items.exEn: Specialists can support several teams, typically for cross-cutting or highly technical test types.
items.qAr: ما فائدة وجود فريق اختبار مستقل في مؤسسة تعمل بـ Agile؟
items.exAr: يمكن للمتخصصين دعم عدة فرق، خاصةً في أنواع الاختبار العابرة للفرق أو عالية التقنية.

items.q: Which tool is most commonly used to communicate the status of testing within an Agile team on a daily basis?

o.A: A formal test summary report distributed by email
o.B: The organization's quality management system
o.C: The annual audit report
o.D: The task board together with the daily stand-up meeting

items.exEn: The task board makes the state of each testing task visible to everyone, and the stand-up covers blockers.
items.qAr: أي أداة تُستخدم عادةً لإيصال حالة الاختبار داخل فريق Agile بشكل يومي؟
items.exAr: يُظهر الـ task board حالة كل مهمة اختبار للجميع، بينما يعالج الـ stand-up المعوّقات.

items.q: What does a burndown chart show?

o.A: The number of defects fixed by each developer
o.B: The cumulative cost of the project to date
o.C: The percentage of automated versus manual test cases
o.D: The amount of work remaining against the time left in the iteration or release

items.exEn: It visualizes remaining effort over time, making it obvious whether the team is on track.
items.qAr: ماذا يُظهر الـ burndown chart؟
items.exAr: يعرض الجهد المتبقي عبر الزمن، ما يوضّح ما إذا كان الفريق يسير وفق المسار المطلوب.

items.q: In the daily stand-up meeting, what should a tester typically communicate?

o.A: What was tested, what will be tested next and any impediment blocking the testing
o.B: A detailed walkthrough of every defect found the previous day
o.C: The full test execution report for the release
o.D: A performance evaluation of the developers

items.exEn: The stand-up is a short synchronization meeting, not a status report or a problem-solving session.
items.qAr: ما الذي يُتوقَّع أن يوصله المختبِر عادةً في اجتماع الـ daily stand-up؟
items.exAr: الـ stand-up اجتماع تزامن قصير، وليس تقرير حالة ولا جلسة لحل المشكلات.

items.q: Which metric is useful for communicating test progress inside an iteration?

o.A: The number of test cases passed, failed and blocked relative to those planned
o.B: The number of lines of code committed by each developer
o.C: The number of meetings attended by the tester
o.D: The size of the test documentation in pages

items.exEn: Pass, fail and blocked counts against the plan show whether the stories are converging on done.
items.qAr: أي مقياس مفيد لإيصال تقدم الاختبار داخل التكرار؟
items.exAr: تُظهر أعداد النجاح والفشل والحظر مقارنةً بالخطة ما إذا كانت الـ user stories تقترب من الاكتمال.

items.q: Why does regression risk grow as an Agile project progresses?

o.A: Because the team's velocity always decreases over time
o.B: Each iteration adds functionality and changes existing code, so the amount that must be re-tested keeps growing
o.C: Because acceptance criteria become less detailed
o.D: Because the product owner changes the priorities

items.exEn: Every increment enlarges the surface that later changes could break, which is why automation becomes essential.
items.qAr: لماذا يتزايد خطر الانحدار (regression risk) مع تقدّم مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: كل increment يوسّع المساحة التي قد تكسرها التغييرات اللاحقة، ولهذا تصبح الأتمتة ضرورية.

items.q: What is the most effective way to manage regression risk in an Agile project?

o.A: Adding a manual regression phase after the last iteration
o.B: Executing the full regression suite manually at the end of every iteration
o.C: Restricting changes to the code after the third iteration
o.D: Automating the regression tests and running them continuously as part of the build

items.exEn: Only automated regression can keep pace with frequent builds and give feedback within minutes.
items.qAr: ما الطريقة الأكثر فاعلية لإدارة خطر الانحدار في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: الأتمتة وحدها قادرة على مجاراة البناء المتكرر وإعطاء تغذية راجعة خلال دقائق.

items.q: Why must the automated test suite be maintained continuously?

o.A: Changes and refactoring make some tests obsolete or misleading, and obsolete tests must be updated or removed
o.B: Because the tests expire after a fixed number of executions
o.C: Because test tools require the scripts to be rewritten every release
o.D: Because automated tests lose coverage if they are not re-recorded

items.exEn: An unmaintained suite produces false alarms, loses the team's trust and eventually gets ignored.
items.qAr: لماذا يجب صيانة مجموعة الاختبارات المؤتمتة باستمرار؟
items.exAr: المجموعة غير المُصانة تُنتج إنذارات كاذبة وتفقد ثقة الفريق، وينتهي بها الأمر إلى التجاهل.

items.q: Which skill is particularly important for a tester working in an Agile team?

o.A: Working independently without involving the rest of the team
o.B: Producing the largest possible volume of test documentation
o.C: Collaborating and communicating constructively while still raising quality concerns clearly
o.D: Approving the release without consulting the product owner

items.exEn: The Agile tester combines teamwork and communication skills with a critical, questioning mindset.
items.qAr: أي مهارة تُعدّ مهمة بشكل خاص للمختبِر العامل ضمن فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: يجمع مختبِر Agile بين مهارات العمل الجماعي والتواصل وبين عقلية نقدية تطرح الأسئلة.

items.q: What is typically done during 'sprint zero' (the initial iteration)?

o.A: Setting up the initial backlog, test environments, tools, the definition of done and the initial test approach
o.B: Delivering the first customer-facing feature to production
o.C: Executing the full regression suite of the previous release
o.D: Running the first retrospective on the delivered increment

items.exEn: Sprint zero prepares the ground; it produces little or no customer-visible functionality.
items.qAr: ما الذي يُنجَز عادةً خلال «sprint zero» (التكرار التمهيدي)؟
items.exAr: يهيّئ الـ sprint zero الأرضية، ولا يُنتج عادةً وظائف مرئية للعميل.

items.q: How should a tester contribute to the definition of done?

o.A: By ensuring it includes the testing criteria the team must satisfy before an item is considered complete
o.B: By writing it alone and presenting it to the team
o.C: By limiting it to the acceptance criteria of individual stories
o.D: By excluding non-functional aspects to keep it achievable

items.exEn: The definition of done is agreed by the whole team, and the tester makes sure testing is genuinely part of it.
items.qAr: كيف ينبغي أن يساهم المختبِر في الـ definition of done؟
items.exAr: يتفق الفريق كله على الـ definition of done، ويحرص المختبِر على أن يكون الاختبار جزءاً حقيقياً منه.

items.q: In a whole-team approach, who may write automated tests?

o.A: Testers only, because automation is a testing responsibility
o.B: Developers only, because automation requires programming
o.C: An external automation vendor only
o.D: Developers and testers together, according to the level of the test and the skills available

items.exEn: Unit tests are usually written by developers, while testers often own higher-level automation, but the work is shared.
items.qAr: في نهج الفريق الكامل، من الذي يمكنه كتابة الاختبارات المؤتمتة؟
items.exAr: يكتب المطوّرون عادةً اختبارات الوحدة، بينما يتولى المختبِرون غالباً الأتمتة عالية المستوى، لكن العمل مشترك.

items.q: What is meant by the tester acting as a 'quality coach' in an Agile team?

o.A: Auditing the team's compliance with the organizational process
o.B: Taking responsibility for approving all releases personally
o.C: Reviewing the performance of individual team members
o.D: Transferring testing knowledge to the team so quality becomes a shared practice rather than one person's task

items.exEn: Coaching spreads testing skills across the team instead of concentrating them in a single role.
items.qAr: ماذا يُقصد بأن يكون المختبِر «quality coach» في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: يعمل التدريب على نشر مهارات الاختبار في الفريق بدل حصرها في دور واحد.

items.q: Which practice best supports early tester involvement in an Agile team?

o.A: Participating in the refinement of user stories and the definition of acceptance criteria before development starts
o.B: Waiting for the build to be deployed before reading the user story
o.C: Reviewing the code after it has been merged to the main branch
o.D: Testing only the stories that have already been marked as done

items.exEn: The earliest and cheapest defects to remove are the ones found in the story itself.
items.qAr: أي ممارسة تدعم مشاركة المختبِر المبكرة في فريق Agile بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: أرخص الـ defects وأبكرها إزالةً هي تلك التي تُكتشف في الـ user story نفسها.

items.q: How should a tester handle a user story whose acceptance criteria are vague?

o.A: Raise it with the product owner and the team so the criteria are clarified before the story is accepted into the iteration
o.B: Accept the story and write test cases based on personal assumptions
o.C: Reject the story permanently and remove it from the backlog
o.D: Wait until the end of the iteration and report it as a defect

items.exEn: A story that cannot be tested cannot be shown to be done; clarification belongs before the iteration, not after.
items.qAr: كيف ينبغي أن يتعامل المختبِر مع user story معاييرها غير واضحة؟
items.exAr: الـ user story التي لا يمكن اختبارها لا يمكن إثبات اكتمالها، والتوضيح مكانه قبل التكرار لا بعده.

items.q: What is the main purpose of tracking velocity across iterations?

o.A: To compare the productivity of individual team members
o.B: To calculate the bonus paid to the development team
o.C: To measure the quality of the delivered increment
o.D: To help the team forecast how much work it can realistically take on in future iterations

items.exEn: Velocity is a planning aid for the team itself, not a performance measure for individuals or a quality metric.
items.qAr: ما الهدف الرئيسي من تتبع الـ velocity عبر التكرارات؟
items.exAr: الـ velocity أداة تخطيط للفريق نفسه، وليست مقياس أداء للأفراد ولا مقياس جودة.

items.q: Why should defect reports in an Agile team often be lighter than in traditional projects?

o.A: Because defects found in Agile projects are always trivial
o.B: Because Agile teams are not required to track defects at all
o.C: Because the defect is usually discussed and fixed within the same iteration, often directly with the developer
o.D: Because the product owner fixes the defects personally

items.exEn: Short feedback loops replace much of the written detail; defects that outlive the iteration still need full documentation.
items.qAr: لماذا تكون تقارير الـ defects في فرق Agile أخف عادةً منها في المشاريع التقليدية؟
items.exAr: حلقات التغذية الراجعة القصيرة تغني عن كثير من التفاصيل المكتوبة، أما الـ defects التي تتجاوز التكرار فتحتاج توثيقاً كاملاً.

items.q: What is a suitable response when the team cannot finish testing a story before the end of the iteration?

o.A: The story is not done and is carried over or returned to the backlog, rather than being marked complete
o.B: The story is marked as done and the remaining testing is scheduled for a later iteration
o.C: The definition of done is relaxed for that story
o.D: The story is accepted and the missing tests are recorded as defects

items.exEn: The definition of done is not negotiable per story; partial work returns to the backlog.
items.qAr: ما التصرف المناسب عندما لا يتمكن الفريق من إنهاء اختبار user story قبل نهاية التكرار؟
items.exAr: الـ definition of done غير قابل للتفاوض حسب كل user story، والعمل غير المكتمل يعود إلى الـ backlog.

items.q: Why is traceability still useful in Agile projects?

o.A: It is required in order to calculate the team's velocity
o.B: It replaces the need for acceptance criteria
o.C: It guarantees that regression tests never need updating
o.D: It links user stories to their tests and results, which supports coverage analysis, audits and impact assessment

items.exEn: Lightweight traceability, usually maintained in the backlog tool, still answers what was tested and what a change affects.
items.qAr: لماذا تبقى إمكانية التتبع مفيدة في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: التتبع الخفيف، الذي يُدار عادةً في أداة الـ backlog، يجيب عن سؤال: ماذا اختُبر، وما الذي يؤثر فيه التغيير.

items.q: What does it mean that quality is a shared responsibility in Agile?

o.A: Every team member performs the same testing tasks
o.B: The product owner signs off every test case
o.C: Every role contributes to preventing and detecting defects, rather than quality being delegated to testers alone
o.D: The scrum master is accountable for the defects found in production

items.exEn: Shared responsibility changes behavior: developers test their own work and testers contribute to design discussions.
items.qAr: ماذا يعني أن الجودة مسؤولية مشتركة في Agile؟
items.exAr: المسؤولية المشتركة تغيّر السلوك: المطوّرون يختبرون عملهم، والمختبِرون يشاركون في نقاشات التصميم.

items.q: Which of the following best describes the Agile testing mindset?

o.A: Being proactive, collaborative and focused on preventing defects as much as on finding them
o.B: Being a gatekeeper who decides alone whether the product can be released
o.C: Documenting every test in detail before any execution can start
o.D: Avoiding involvement in development discussions to remain objective

items.exEn: Prevention through early collaboration is as valuable as detection through execution.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يصف عقلية الاختبار في Agile بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: المنع عبر التعاون المبكر لا يقل قيمةً عن الاكتشاف عبر التنفيذ.

items.q: What should happen to testing tasks on the task board during the iteration?

o.A: They are tracked separately in the test management tool only
o.B: They are added to the board only after development is finished
o.C: They are hidden until the story is ready for acceptance
o.D: They are visible alongside the development tasks and move through the same workflow states

items.exEn: Making testing tasks visible keeps the whole team aware of the real progress of each story.
items.qAr: ماذا يجب أن يحدث لمهام الاختبار على الـ task board خلال التكرار؟
items.exAr: إظهار مهام الاختبار يُبقي الفريق كله على اطلاع بالتقدم الحقيقي لكل user story.

items.q: What is the correct sequence of steps in Test-Driven Development (TDD)?

o.A: Write the code, then write a test that passes, then refactor
o.B: Write the acceptance criteria, then the code, then the unit tests
o.C: Write all the unit tests for the feature, then implement the whole feature
o.D: Write a failing test, write just enough code to pass it, then refactor

items.exEn: TDD works in very short red-green-refactor cycles, and the tests become an executable specification of the code.
items.qAr: ما التسلسل الصحيح لخطوات التطوير المقاد بالاختبار (TDD)؟
items.exAr: يعمل الـ TDD في دورات قصيرة جداً (فشل ← نجاح ← إعادة هيكلة)، وتتحول الاختبارات إلى مواصفة قابلة للتنفيذ للكود.

items.q: At which level is Test-Driven Development primarily applied?

o.A: The user acceptance level
o.B: The unit or component level
o.C: The performance testing level
o.D: The system integration level

items.exEn: TDD mainly drives the design of the code itself and is therefore a unit-level practice.
items.qAr: على أي مستوى يُطبَّق الـ TDD بشكل أساسي؟
items.exAr: يوجّه الـ TDD تصميم الكود نفسه، ولذلك يُعدّ ممارسة على مستوى الوحدة.

items.q: What characterizes Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD)?

o.A: Acceptance tests are written by the tester after the feature has been delivered
o.B: Acceptance tests replace all unit tests written by developers
o.C: Acceptance tests are derived automatically from the source code
o.D: Acceptance tests are defined collaboratively in a specification workshop before development begins

items.exEn: ATDD brings business, development and testing together to agree on concrete examples up front.
items.qAr: ما الذي يميّز التطوير المقاد باختبار القبول (ATDD)؟
items.exAr: يجمع الـ ATDD الأعمال والتطوير والاختبار للاتفاق على أمثلة ملموسة قبل البدء.

items.q: Which format is characteristic of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)?

o.A: Input / Process / Output
o.B: Given / When / Then
o.C: Plan / Do / Check / Act
o.D: Arrange / Build / Deploy

items.exEn: The Given-When-Then structure expresses scenarios in a language shared by business and technical people.
items.qAr: أي صيغة تميّز التطوير المقاد بالسلوك (BDD)؟
items.exAr: تعبّر صيغة Given-When-Then عن السيناريوهات بلغة مشتركة بين الأعمال والجانب التقني.

items.q: What is the main idea of the test pyramid?

o.A: Have many fast tests at the unit level and progressively fewer tests at the higher, slower levels
o.B: Have many tests through the user interface and few unit tests
o.C: Give every test level exactly the same number of tests
o.D: Replace all levels with end-to-end tests once the system is stable

items.exEn: Low-level tests are cheap, fast and precise, which keeps the feedback loop short as the suite grows.
items.qAr: ما الفكرة الأساسية لهرم الاختبار (test pyramid)؟
items.exAr: الاختبارات منخفضة المستوى رخيصة وسريعة ودقيقة، ما يُبقي حلقة التغذية الراجعة قصيرة مع نمو المجموعة.

items.q: Why are large numbers of automated tests through the user interface considered problematic?

o.A: They cannot detect functional defects at all
o.B: They are slow, fragile and expensive to maintain when the interface changes
o.C: They cannot be executed inside a continuous integration pipeline
o.D: They require access to the source code of the application

items.exEn: UI tests break on cosmetic changes, so the pyramid pushes coverage down to the cheaper levels.
items.qAr: لماذا يُعدّ الإفراط في الاختبارات المؤتمتة عبر واجهة المستخدم مشكلة؟
items.exAr: تنكسر اختبارات الواجهة مع أي تغيير شكلي، لذلك يدفع الهرم بالتغطية نحو المستويات الأرخص.

items.q: In the Agile testing quadrants, which tests are technology-facing and support the team?

o.A: Exploratory and usability testing
o.B: Performance and security testing
o.C: Unit and component tests, usually automated
o.D: Functional examples and story tests

items.exEn: Quadrant 1 holds the automated technology-facing tests that guide development.
items.qAr: في مربعات الاختبار في Agile، أي اختبارات تكون موجَّهة للتقنية وداعمة للفريق؟
items.exAr: يضم المربع الأول الاختبارات التقنية المؤتمتة التي توجّه التطوير.

items.q: In the Agile testing quadrants, which tests are business-facing and support the team?

o.A: Unit tests and component integration tests
o.B: Exploratory testing and user acceptance testing
o.C: Functional tests, examples, story tests and prototypes
o.D: Load, stress and reliability testing

items.exEn: Quadrant 2 defines what the feature should do, in business language, before and during development.
items.qAr: في مربعات الاختبار، أي اختبارات تكون موجَّهة للأعمال وداعمة للفريق؟
items.exAr: يحدد المربع الثاني ما يجب أن تفعله الميزة بلغة الأعمال، قبل التطوير وأثناءه.

items.q: In the Agile testing quadrants, which tests are business-facing and critique the product?

o.A: Unit tests and component tests
o.B: Performance and security testing
o.C: Story tests and functional examples
o.D: Exploratory testing, usability testing and user acceptance testing

items.exEn: Quadrant 3 evaluates the product through the eyes of a real user and is largely manual.
items.qAr: في مربعات الاختبار، أي اختبارات تكون موجَّهة للأعمال وناقدة للمنتج؟
items.exAr: يقيّم المربع الثالث المنتج بعيون المستخدم الحقيقي، وهو يدوي في معظمه.

items.q: In the Agile testing quadrants, which tests are technology-facing and critique the product?

o.A: Performance, load, stress, security and maintainability testing
o.B: Story tests and business examples
o.C: Usability and user acceptance testing
o.D: Unit tests written during TDD

items.exEn: Quadrant 4 covers the quality characteristics that normally require specialized tools.
items.qAr: في مربعات الاختبار، أي اختبارات تكون موجَّهة للتقنية وناقدة للمنتج؟
items.exAr: يغطي المربع الرابع خصائص الجودة التي تتطلب عادةً أدوات متخصصة.

items.q: Which statement about the testing quadrants is correct?

o.A: The quadrants must be executed strictly in the order 1, 2, 3, 4
o.B: Each quadrant belongs to a separate iteration
o.C: Only the first two quadrants apply to Agile projects
o.D: A team may run tests from any quadrant in any iteration, depending on the risks of the stories being built

items.exEn: The quadrants are a way to think about coverage, not a sequence to follow.
items.qAr: أي عبارة حول مربعات الاختبار صحيحة؟
items.exAr: المربعات طريقة للتفكير في التغطية، وليست تسلسلاً يجب اتباعه.

items.q: What is the purpose of quality risk analysis in an Agile project?

o.A: To calculate the exact number of defects that will be found
o.B: To assign responsibility for defects to specific developers
o.C: To identify what could go wrong with the product so the test effort can be focused where it matters most
o.D: To decide the length of the iteration

items.exEn: Risk analysis drives depth of testing: high-risk areas get more attention, low-risk areas get less.
items.qAr: ما الهدف من تحليل مخاطر الجودة في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: يوجّه تحليل المخاطر عمق الاختبار: المناطق عالية الخطورة تنال اهتماماً أكبر، والعكس صحيح.

items.q: When is quality risk analysis typically performed in an Agile project?

o.A: Only once, at the start of the project
o.B: Only after the first production release
o.C: In release planning and again, in more detail, in each iteration planning session
o.D: Only when a severe defect is found

items.exEn: Risks are revisited every iteration because the product, the code base and the environment keep changing.
items.qAr: متى يُجرى تحليل مخاطر الجودة عادةً في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: تُعاد مراجعة المخاطر كل تكرار لأن المنتج والكود والبيئة في تغيّر مستمر.

items.q: Who should participate in quality risk analysis in an Agile team?

o.A: The tester alone, since quality is the tester's responsibility
o.B: The product owner alone, since risk is a business decision
o.C: The scrum master alone, as the owner of the process
o.D: The whole team, including business representatives, developers and testers

items.exEn: Different perspectives identify different risks; business impact and technical likelihood both need input.
items.qAr: من الذي ينبغي أن يشارك في تحليل مخاطر الجودة داخل فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: المنظورات المختلفة تكشف مخاطر مختلفة: الأثر على الأعمال والاحتمالية التقنية كلاهما يحتاج مساهمة.

items.q: How is the level of a quality risk determined?

o.A: By counting the number of test cases written for the feature
o.B: By combining the likelihood of the problem occurring with the impact it would have
o.C: By measuring the size of the user story in story points
o.D: By counting the defects reported in the previous iteration

items.exEn: Likelihood is mostly technical, impact is mostly business — which is why both perspectives are needed.
items.qAr: كيف يُحدَّد مستوى خطر الجودة؟
items.exAr: الاحتمالية تقنية في معظمها والأثر يخص الأعمال، ولهذا يلزم المنظوران معاً.

items.q: What is planning poker used for?

o.A: Prioritizing the product backlog by business value
o.B: Estimating the effort of backlog items collaboratively, so that every team member contributes independently
o.C: Selecting which defects to fix in the current iteration
o.D: Measuring the velocity achieved in the previous iteration

items.exEn: Each member estimates privately and then the differences are discussed, which surfaces hidden assumptions.
items.qAr: فيمَ يُستخدم الـ planning poker؟
items.exAr: يقدّر كل عضو بشكل منفرد ثم تُناقش الفروق، ما يكشف الافتراضات الخفية.

items.q: What should a story point estimate include in a whole-team approach?

o.A: The development effort only, with testing estimated separately by the tester
o.B: The number of test cases required for the story
o.C: The number of working days of the most experienced developer
o.D: All the effort needed to bring the story to done, including the testing tasks

items.exEn: If testing is not inside the estimate, the story is systematically under-estimated and cannot reach done.
items.qAr: ماذا يجب أن يتضمن تقدير النقاط (story points) في نهج الفريق الكامل؟
items.exAr: إذا لم يُدرج الاختبار في التقدير، تُقدَّر القصة بأقل من حجمها الحقيقي ولا يمكنها بلوغ حالة done.

items.q: What does velocity tell an Agile team?

o.A: How many defects the team introduces per iteration
o.B: How productive each individual developer is
o.C: How many story points the team has typically completed per iteration, which supports future forecasting
o.D: How much of the code base is covered by automated tests

items.exEn: Velocity is an empirical planning input derived from previous iterations, not a target to maximize.
items.qAr: ماذا تخبر الـ velocity فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: الـ velocity مدخل تخطيط تجريبي مشتق من التكرارات السابقة، وليست هدفاً يُسعى لتعظيمه.

items.q: Which statement about estimating test effort in Agile is correct?

o.A: Testing tasks are estimated by the team as part of the story, not added afterwards
o.B: Testing effort is estimated by the test manager outside the team
o.C: Testing effort is assumed to be a fixed percentage of development effort
o.D: Testing effort is estimated only for stories that contain defects

items.exEn: Estimating together keeps the commitment realistic and makes testing visible in the plan.
items.qAr: أي عبارة حول تقدير جهد الاختبار في Agile صحيحة؟
items.exAr: التقدير الجماعي يُبقي الالتزام واقعياً ويجعل الاختبار ظاهراً في الخطة.

items.q: What is the role of acceptance criteria in test design?

o.A: They replace the need for exploratory testing
o.B: They describe the internal design of the solution
o.C: They are the primary basis from which the acceptance tests for the story are derived
o.D: They are used only by the product owner during the review

items.exEn: Well-written acceptance criteria translate almost directly into concrete test cases.
items.qAr: ما دور معايير القبول في تصميم الاختبارات؟
items.exAr: معايير القبول المكتوبة جيداً تتحول تقريباً مباشرةً إلى حالات اختبار ملموسة.

items.q: Which black-box technique is most appropriate for a field that accepts a numeric range?

o.A: State transition testing
o.B: Statement and branch coverage
o.C: Equivalence partitioning combined with boundary value analysis
o.D: Pairwise testing of unrelated fields

items.exEn: Partitions reduce the number of cases; boundaries target the values where defects cluster.
items.qAr: أي تقنية black-box هي الأنسب لحقل يقبل نطاقاً رقمياً؟
items.exAr: تقلل الأقسام عدد الحالات، بينما تستهدف الحدود القيم التي تتركز عندها الـ defects.

items.q: Which technique is most suitable for a story describing several business rules with combinations of conditions?

o.A: Decision table testing
o.B: Boundary value analysis
o.C: State transition testing
o.D: Error guessing

items.exEn: Decision tables make the combinations explicit and reveal rules the story forgot to specify.
items.qAr: أي تقنية هي الأنسب لقصة تصف عدة قواعد أعمال بتركيبات من الشروط؟
items.exAr: تُظهر جداول القرار التركيبات صراحةً وتكشف القواعد التي أغفلتها القصة.

items.q: Which technique fits a feature in which the allowed actions depend on the current status of an order?

o.A: Equivalence partitioning
o.B: Load testing
o.C: Checklist-based testing
o.D: State transition testing

items.exEn: The technique models states, events and transitions, including the transitions that should not be possible.
items.qAr: أي تقنية تناسب ميزة تعتمد فيها الإجراءات المسموحة على حالة الطلب الحالية؟
items.exAr: تنمذج هذه التقنية الحالات والأحداث والانتقالات، بما فيها الانتقالات التي يجب ألا تكون ممكنة.

items.q: What is the purpose of a test charter in exploratory testing?

o.A: To list every step the tester must follow in order
o.B: To record the defects found after the session ends
o.C: To state what will be explored, how, and what kind of problems are being looked for
o.D: To define the acceptance criteria of the user story

items.exEn: The charter gives the session a mission while leaving the tester free to follow what is found.
items.qAr: ما الهدف من الـ test charter في الاختبار الاستكشافي؟
items.exAr: يمنح الـ charter الجلسة مهمة محددة مع إبقاء حرية المختبِر في متابعة ما يكتشفه.

items.q: What characterizes session-based test management?

o.A: All exploratory tests are scripted in advance and reviewed
o.B: Exploratory testing is organized into timeboxed sessions with a charter and a debriefing
o.C: Sessions continue until the tester decides that testing is complete
o.D: Each session is limited to a single test case

items.exEn: The timebox, the charter and the debrief make exploratory testing manageable and reportable.
items.qAr: ما الذي يميّز إدارة الاختبار المعتمدة على الجلسات (session-based test management)؟
items.exAr: الوقت المحدد والـ charter وجلسة المراجعة تجعل الاختبار الاستكشافي قابلاً للإدارة وإعداد التقارير.

items.q: What is typically covered in the debriefing after an exploratory test session?

o.A: The performance appraisal of the tester who ran the session
o.B: The detailed scripts that will be automated in the next iteration
o.C: The prioritization of the product backlog
o.D: What was covered, what was found, what obstacles appeared and what should be explored next

items.exEn: The debrief turns an exploratory session into shared, reportable information for the team.
items.qAr: ما الذي تتم تغطيته عادةً في جلسة المراجعة (debriefing) بعد جلسة اختبار استكشافي؟
items.exAr: تحوّل جلسة المراجعة الجلسة الاستكشافية إلى معلومات مشتركة قابلة للمشاركة مع الفريق.

items.q: Why is exploratory testing especially valuable in Agile projects?

o.A: Documentation is light and changes fast, so it finds problems that scripted tests would miss
o.B: It removes the need to automate regression tests
o.C: It guarantees complete coverage of the acceptance criteria
o.D: It can be fully executed by automation tools

items.exEn: Exploratory testing complements automated checks: automation confirms what is known, exploration finds the unknown.
items.qAr: لماذا يكون الاختبار الاستكشافي ذا قيمة خاصة في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: يكمل الاختبار الاستكشافي الفحوصات المؤتمتة: الأتمتة تؤكد المعروف، والاستكشاف يكتشف المجهول.

items.q: How should exploratory testing and test automation be combined in an Agile team?

o.A: Automation covers the repetitive regression checks, freeing tester time for exploration
o.B: Exploratory testing replaces automation once the suite becomes large
o.C: Automation replaces exploratory testing once coverage is high
o.D: The two approaches should be assigned to separate teams

items.exEn: Each covers what the other cannot: repeatability versus human judgement.
items.qAr: كيف ينبغي الجمع بين الاختبار الاستكشافي والأتمتة في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: كل منهما يغطي ما لا يغطيه الآخر: القابلية للتكرار مقابل الحكم البشري.

items.q: Which tool category directly supports managing the iteration backlog and the task board?

o.A: Static analysis tools
o.B: Performance testing tools
o.C: Task management and application lifecycle tools
o.D: Virtualization platforms

items.exEn: These tools hold the stories, tasks and their states, and generate the burndown charts used for reporting.
items.qAr: أي فئة أدوات تدعم مباشرةً إدارة الـ iteration backlog والـ task board؟
items.exAr: تحتفظ هذه الأدوات بالقصص والمهام وحالاتها، وتولّد الـ burndown charts المستخدمة في التقارير.

items.q: Which tool category supports communication and information sharing in an Agile team?

o.A: Build automation servers
o.B: Test data generation tools
o.C: Wikis, instant messaging and desktop sharing tools
o.D: Code coverage measurement tools

items.exEn: They preserve shared knowledge without producing the heavy documentation Agile tries to avoid.
items.qAr: أي فئة أدوات تدعم التواصل ومشاركة المعلومات في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: تحفظ هذه الأدوات المعرفة المشتركة دون إنتاج التوثيق الثقيل الذي تتجنبه Agile.

items.q: What is the main role of software build and distribution tools in an Agile project?

o.A: Designing the test cases for the new stories
o.B: Measuring the team's velocity across iterations
o.C: Recording the minutes of the daily stand-up
o.D: Producing a build automatically and deploying it to the test environment on every change

items.exEn: Automated build and deployment is what makes continuous integration and fast feedback possible.
items.qAr: ما الدور الرئيسي لأدوات البناء والتوزيع في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: البناء والنشر الآليان هما ما يجعل التكامل المستمر والتغذية الراجعة السريعة ممكنَين.

items.q: Why should testware be kept under version control together with the source code?

o.A: So the tests always match the version of the software they are meant to verify
o.B: So testers can avoid using the build server
o.C: Because automated tests cannot run outside a repository
o.D: Because version control automatically updates obsolete tests

items.exEn: Tests and code evolve together; separating them produces mismatches and false failures.
items.qAr: لماذا يجب حفظ مخرجات الاختبار في نظام إصدارات مع الكود المصدري؟
items.exAr: تتطور الاختبارات مع الكود، وفصلها يُنتج عدم تطابق وإخفاقات كاذبة.

items.q: What is the main benefit of using test data generation tools in Agile projects?

o.A: They remove the need for a test environment
o.B: They quickly produce the volume and variety of data that frequent test cycles require
o.C: They automatically detect defects in the application
o.D: They generate the acceptance criteria for user stories

items.exEn: Preparing realistic data by hand is usually the slowest step in setting up a test cycle.
items.qAr: ما الفائدة الرئيسية من أدوات توليد بيانات الاختبار في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: تحضير بيانات واقعية يدوياً هو عادةً أبطأ خطوة في تجهيز دورة الاختبار.

items.q: How do cloud and virtualization technologies support testing in Agile projects?

o.A: They remove the need to test on real configurations entirely
o.B: They guarantee that performance results match production exactly
o.C: They allow test environments and configurations to be created, reset and scaled quickly on demand
o.D: They replace the need for configuration management

items.exEn: Fast environment provisioning removes one of the most common bottlenecks in short iterations.
items.qAr: كيف تدعم تقنيات الحوسبة السحابية والمحاكاة الافتراضية الاختبار في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: التجهيز السريع للبيئات يزيل أحد أكثر الاختناقات شيوعاً في التكرارات القصيرة.

items.q: Which tool category is used to record the outcome of test execution and report progress?

o.A: Source code compilers
o.B: Requirements elicitation workshops
o.C: Test management and defect tracking tools
o.D: Desktop sharing tools

items.exEn: They provide the execution history and the metrics used in the team's status reporting.
items.qAr: أي فئة أدوات تُستخدم لتسجيل نتائج تنفيذ الاختبار وإعداد تقارير التقدم؟
items.exAr: توفّر هذه الأدوات سجل التنفيذ والمقاييس المستخدمة في تقارير حالة الفريق.

items.q: What is a key risk of automating a test before the feature design has stabilized?

o.A: The script will not run inside the continuous integration pipeline
o.B: The script will need repeated rework, and the maintenance cost may exceed the benefit
o.C: The script will be unable to detect functional defects
o.D: The script will make the manual tests invalid

items.exEn: Automating a moving target is expensive; stability is a precondition for a good return on automation.
items.qAr: ما الخطر الرئيسي لأتمتة اختبار قبل استقرار تصميم الميزة؟
items.exAr: أتمتة هدف متحرك مكلفة، واستقرار التصميم شرط مسبق لعائد جيد من الأتمتة.

items.q: A story adds a new payment method to an existing checkout flow. Which testing is most clearly required in addition to testing the new method?

o.A: Usability testing of the login screen
o.B: Regression testing of the existing checkout flow
o.C: Localization testing of the entire application
o.D: Installation testing on all supported devices

items.exEn: Changes to shared flows can break previously working paths, which is exactly what regression testing targets.
items.qAr: قصة تضيف وسيلة دفع جديدة إلى مسار شراء قائم. ما الاختبار المطلوب بوضوح إضافةً إلى اختبار الوسيلة الجديدة؟
items.exAr: التغييرات في المسارات المشتركة قد تكسر مسارات كانت تعمل، وهذا تحديداً ما يستهدفه اختبار الانحدار.

items.q: During an iteration, a tester discovers that a story's acceptance criteria conflict with an existing feature. What is the most appropriate action?

o.A: Test the story exactly as written and report the existing feature as a defect
o.B: Postpone the discussion until the retrospective
o.C: Choose the interpretation that requires the least testing effort
o.D: Raise it immediately with the product owner and the team so the conflict is resolved within the iteration

items.exEn: Short feedback loops are the point of Agile: an unresolved conflict will otherwise ship as a defect.
items.qAr: أثناء تكرار، يكتشف المختبِر أن معايير قبول قصة تتعارض مع ميزة قائمة. ما التصرف الأنسب؟
items.exAr: حلقات التغذية الراجعة القصيرة هي جوهر Agile، وإلا فإن التعارض غير المحلول سيُشحن كـ defect.

items.q: A team's automated regression suite takes six hours to run and is therefore executed only overnight. What is the most appropriate improvement?

o.A: Delete the slowest tests from the suite
o.B: Return to executing the regression tests manually
o.C: Run the suite only before each release
o.D: Restructure the suite so that a fast subset runs on every build and the full suite runs less frequently

items.exEn: A layered strategy keeps feedback fast without giving up the depth of the full suite.
items.qAr: مجموعة اختبارات انحدار مؤتمتة تستغرق ست ساعات ولذلك تُنفَّذ ليلاً فقط. ما التحسين الأنسب؟
items.exAr: الاستراتيجية الطبقية تُبقي التغذية الراجعة سريعة دون التخلي عن عمق المجموعة الكاملة.

items.q: The product owner is unavailable during the iteration and questions about a story remain unanswered. What is the main risk for testing?

o.A: The automated tests will fail to compile
o.B: The team will build and test against assumptions, so the feature may be verified but not valid
o.C: The velocity of the iteration cannot be calculated
o.D: The task board cannot be updated

items.exEn: Without the business voice, the team can pass all its tests and still deliver the wrong behavior.
items.qAr: الـ product owner غير متاح خلال التكرار وتبقى أسئلة حول قصة دون إجابة. ما الخطر الرئيسي على الاختبار؟
items.exAr: بغياب صوت الأعمال قد ينجح الفريق في كل اختباراته ويسلّم مع ذلك سلوكاً خاطئاً.

items.q: A story is marked done, but no non-functional aspects were considered. Which practice would have prevented this?

o.A: Increasing the number of unit tests for the story
o.B: Including non-functional criteria in the definition of done and in the risk analysis of the story
o.C: Extending the length of the iteration
o.D: Assigning the story to a more experienced developer

items.exEn: Performance, security and usability expectations must be explicit, or they are silently dropped.
items.qAr: قصة وُضعت كمكتملة دون النظر في الجوانب غير الوظيفية. أي ممارسة كانت ستمنع ذلك؟
items.exAr: يجب أن تكون توقعات الأداء والأمان وقابلية الاستخدام صريحة، وإلا أُسقطت بصمت.

items.q: Which approach best supports testing a story that depends on a service that is not yet available?

o.A: Using a stub, mock or service virtualization to simulate the missing service
o.B: Postponing all testing of the story until the next iteration
o.C: Testing only the user interface of the story
o.D: Marking the story as done and testing it after release

items.exEn: Simulating the dependency keeps the story testable inside the iteration instead of blocking it.
items.qAr: أي مقاربة تدعم بشكل أفضل اختبار قصة تعتمد على خدمة غير متاحة بعد؟
items.exAr: محاكاة الاعتمادية تُبقي القصة قابلة للاختبار داخل التكرار بدل تعطيلها.

items.q: What is the most useful measure of whether the team's testing is keeping pace with development?

o.A: The total number of test cases written during the iteration
o.B: The number of hours the testers spent on testing
o.C: The number of stories reaching done within the iteration, rather than merely being coded
o.D: The number of defects reported per developer

items.exEn: Done means coded and tested; counting coded stories hides testing debt until it is too late.
items.qAr: ما المؤشر الأكثر فائدة لمعرفة ما إذا كان اختبار الفريق يواكب التطوير؟
items.exAr: الاكتمال يعني مكتوباً ومختبَراً، أما عدّ القصص المبرمَجة فيخفي دَين الاختبار حتى فوات الأوان.

items.q: Which of the following best describes how defects should be handled within an Agile iteration?

o.A: They are collected and fixed in a dedicated defect-fixing iteration
o.B: They are discussed and, where possible, fixed within the same iteration rather than deferred to a later release
o.C: They are recorded but only fixed after the customer reports them
o.D: They are fixed only if they block the automated build

items.exEn: Fixing defects while the context is fresh is cheaper, and it keeps stories genuinely done.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يصف بشكل أفضل كيفية التعامل مع الـ defects داخل تكرار Agile؟
items.exAr: إصلاح الـ defects والسياق ما زال حاضراً أقل كلفة، ويُبقي القصص مكتملة فعلاً.

items.q: Two sprints before the planned release, the customer asks to change a feature because a competitor has launched a similar product. The team re-prioritizes the backlog to include the change. Which Agile principle does this best illustrate?

o.A: Deliver working software frequently, with a preference for the shorter timescale
o.B: Welcome changing requirements, even late in development, to harness change for the customer's competitive advantage
o.C: Continuous attention to technical excellence and good design enhances agility
o.D: The best architectures, requirements and designs emerge from self-organizing teams

items.exEn: Accepting a late change to give the customer a competitive advantage is the 'welcome changing requirements' principle.
items.qAr: قبل موعد الإصدار المخطط بـ sprintين، طلب العميل تغيير ميزة لأن منافساً أطلق منتجاً مشابهاً، فأعاد الفريق ترتيب أولويات الـ backlog ليشمل التغيير. أي مبدأ من مبادئ Agile يوضحه هذا الموقف بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: قبول تغيير متأخر لمنح العميل ميزة تنافسية هو مبدأ الترحيب بتغيّر المتطلبات حتى في مراحل متأخرة.

items.q: A manager wants to measure progress by counting the number of design documents and test specifications completed each week. According to the Agile principles, what is the primary measure of progress?

o.A: The percentage of planned documents that have been approved
o.B: The number of test cases written per sprint
o.C: Working software
o.D: The number of hours logged by team members

items.exEn: One of the 12 principles states that working software is the primary measure of progress.
items.qAr: يريد أحد المديرين قياس التقدم بعدّ وثائق التصميم ومواصفات الاختبار المنجزة كل أسبوع. وفقاً لمبادئ Agile، ما المقياس الأساسي للتقدم؟
items.exAr: أحد المبادئ الاثني عشر ينص على أن البرمجية العاملة هي المقياس الأساسي للتقدم.

items.q: For the last three sprints, the team has worked overtime every weekend to meet the sprint goal, and quality is starting to drop. Which Agile principle is being ignored?

o.A: Agile processes promote sustainable development; the team should be able to maintain a constant pace indefinitely
o.B: Simplicity, the art of maximizing the amount of work not done, is essential
o.C: Business people and developers must work together daily throughout the project
o.D: Our highest priority is to satisfy the customer through early and continuous delivery

items.exEn: The principle of sustainable development asks for a constant pace that sponsors, developers and users can maintain indefinitely.
items.qAr: خلال آخر ثلاثة sprints، عمل الفريق ساعات إضافية كل عطلة نهاية أسبوع لتحقيق الـ sprint goal، وبدأت الجودة بالتراجع. أي مبدأ من مبادئ Agile يتم تجاهله؟
items.exAr: مبدأ التطوير المستدام يطلب وتيرة ثابتة يستطيع الرعاة والمطورون والمستخدمون الحفاظ عليها إلى أجل غير محدد.

items.q: Which Agile principle is described as 'the art of maximizing the amount of work not done'?

o.A: Technical excellence
o.B: Self-organization
o.C: Sustainable pace
o.D: Simplicity

items.exEn: The principle states that simplicity, the art of maximizing the amount of work not done, is essential.
items.qAr: أي مبدأ من مبادئ Agile يوصف بأنه «فن تعظيم كمية العمل الذي لا يتم إنجازه»؟
items.exAr: ينص المبدأ على أن البساطة، أي فن تعظيم كمية العمل غير المنجز، أمر أساسي.

items.q: A distributed team communicates mainly through long e-mail threads, and misunderstandings about requirements are frequent. Which Agile principle suggests the most effective improvement?

o.A: Deliver working software frequently, from a couple of weeks to a couple of months
o.B: The most efficient and effective method of conveying information to and within a team is face-to-face conversation
o.C: At regular intervals, the team reflects on how to become more effective
o.D: Build projects around motivated individuals and trust them to get the job done

items.exEn: Face-to-face conversation (including video calls for distributed teams) is the most effective way to convey information.
items.qAr: فريق موزّع جغرافياً يتواصل أساساً عبر سلاسل طويلة من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني، وسوء الفهم حول المتطلبات متكرر. أي مبدأ من مبادئ Agile يقترح التحسين الأكثر فاعلية؟
items.exAr: المحادثة وجهاً لوجه هي الطريقة الأكثر كفاءة وفاعلية لنقل المعلومات إلى الفريق وداخله.

items.q: According to the Agile principles, where do the best architectures, requirements and designs come from?

o.A: From a dedicated architecture board outside the team
o.B: From detailed specifications approved before development starts
o.C: From self-organizing teams
o.D: From the product owner alone

items.exEn: The principle states that the best architectures, requirements and designs emerge from self-organizing teams.
items.qAr: وفقاً لمبادئ Agile، من أين تنبثق أفضل البنى المعمارية والمتطلبات والتصاميم؟
items.exAr: ينص المبدأ على أن أفضل البنى والمتطلبات والتصاميم تنبثق من الفرق ذاتية التنظيم.

items.q: Which Agile principle is most directly supported when a business representative is available to answer the team's questions every day?

o.A: Business people and developers must work together daily throughout the project
o.B: Continuous attention to technical excellence enhances agility
o.C: Working software is the primary measure of progress
o.D: Simplicity is essential

items.exEn: Daily collaboration between business people and developers is one of the 12 principles.
items.qAr: أي مبدأ من مبادئ Agile يتم دعمه بشكل مباشر عندما يكون ممثل الأعمال متاحاً للإجابة عن أسئلة الفريق كل يوم؟
items.exAr: التعاون اليومي بين ممثلي الأعمال والمطورين هو أحد المبادئ الاثني عشر.

items.q: A tester insists that a complete, formally reviewed test specification must exist for the whole release before any development starts. Which Agile Manifesto value does this attitude conflict with most?

o.A: Customer collaboration over contract negotiation
o.B: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools
o.C: Simplicity over completeness
o.D: Working software over comprehensive documentation

items.exEn: Insisting on a complete formal specification before any development puts comprehensive documentation ahead of working software.
items.qAr: يُصرّ أحد المختبرين على وجود مواصفات اختبار كاملة ومراجعة رسمياً للإصدار بأكمله قبل بدء أي تطوير. مع أي قيمة من قيم الـ Agile Manifesto يتعارض هذا الموقف أكثر؟
items.exAr: تقدّر Agile البرمجية العاملة أكثر من التوثيق الشامل المسبق، مع بقاء قيمة للتوثيق.

items.q: Which statement best reflects the Agile Manifesto value 'customer collaboration over contract negotiation'?

o.A: Contracts are not needed in Agile projects
o.B: The team negotiates every change request formally with the customer
o.C: The customer should sign off each sprint backlog before the team starts
o.D: Working closely with the customer to understand what they need is more likely to succeed than relying only on contract terms

items.exEn: Customers often find it hard to specify what they need; regular collaboration helps discover their real needs, while contracts still exist.
items.qAr: أي عبارة تعكس بشكل أفضل قيمة الـ Agile Manifesto «التعاون مع العميل أكثر من التفاوض على العقود»؟
items.exAr: يصعب على العملاء غالباً تحديد ما يحتاجونه، والتعاون المنتظم يساعد على اكتشاف احتياجاتهم الفعلية مع بقاء العقود قائمة.

items.q: In the 'power of three' concept, which three roles are typically involved in feature discussions?

o.A: Product owner, scrum master and project manager
o.B: Developer, architect and database administrator
o.C: Business representative, developer and tester
o.D: Tester, test manager and customer

items.exEn: The power of three brings together business, development and testing perspectives in discussions about features.
items.qAr: في مفهوم الـ power of three، ما الأدوار الثلاثة المشاركة عادةً في مناقشات الميزات؟
items.exAr: يجمع الـ power of three وجهات نظر الأعمال والتطوير والاختبار في مناقشة الميزات.

items.q: According to the CTFL-AT syllabus, the whole-team approach is supported by which team size?

o.A: Relatively small teams, typically 3 to 9 people
o.B: Large teams of 15 to 25 people
o.C: Exactly one developer and one tester
o.D: Any size, as long as there is a separate test team

items.exEn: Successful Agile teams are typically small, from three to nine people, which supports the whole-team approach.
items.qAr: وفقاً لمنهج CTFL-AT، ما حجم الفريق الذي يدعم الـ whole-team approach؟
items.exAr: فرق Agile الناجحة صغيرة عادةً، من ثلاثة إلى تسعة أشخاص، وهذا يدعم الـ whole-team approach.

items.q: In an Agile team, a developer says: 'Quality is the testers' job; I only write code.' Which response best reflects the whole-team approach?

o.A: The developer is right, because testers are accountable for quality
o.B: Quality is the responsibility of the product owner only
o.C: Testing should be moved to an independent test team after the sprint
o.D: Everyone on the team is responsible for quality, and developers and testers work together on it

items.exEn: In the whole-team approach the whole team shares responsibility for quality.
items.qAr: في فريق Agile، قال أحد المطورين: «الجودة مسؤولية المختبرين، أنا أكتب الكود فقط». أي رد يعكس الـ whole-team approach بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: في الـ whole-team approach يتشارك الفريق كله مسؤولية الجودة.

items.q: In a sequential project, the customer saw the product for the first time after nine months and found that a key workflow did not match the business process. How would early and frequent feedback in an Agile project have helped most?

o.A: The misunderstanding would have been detected after the first iterations, when it is cheaper to correct
o.B: Testers would not have needed to perform acceptance testing
o.C: The contract would have protected the supplier from the change
o.D: The customer would have written more detailed requirements

items.exEn: Frequent feedback exposes requirement misunderstandings early, when they are cheaper to fix.
items.qAr: في مشروع تتابعي، رأى العميل المنتج لأول مرة بعد تسعة أشهر ووجد أن أحد مسارات العمل الرئيسية لا يطابق إجراءات العمل. كيف كانت الـ early and frequent feedback في مشروع Agile ستساعد أكثر؟
items.exAr: الـ feedback المتكرر يكشف سوء فهم المتطلبات مبكراً عندما يكون تصحيحه أقل تكلفة.

items.q: Which of the following is a benefit of early and frequent feedback listed in the CTFL-AT syllabus?

o.A: It removes the need for a product backlog
o.B: It makes features available for customer use early, so the product better reflects what the customer wants
o.C: It allows the team to postpone integration until the end of the release
o.D: It guarantees that no defects reach production

items.exEn: Benefits include avoiding requirement misunderstandings, clarifying requests, early delivery of features, early quality issues discovery and visibility of productivity.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ من فوائد الـ early and frequent feedback المذكورة في منهج CTFL-AT؟
items.exAr: من الفوائد: تجنب سوء فهم المتطلبات، وتوضيح طلبات العميل، وإتاحة الميزات مبكراً، واكتشاف مشاكل الجودة مبكراً، ووضوح إنتاجية الفريق.

items.q: Which of the following is one of the principles of Extreme Programming (XP)?

o.A: Baby steps
o.B: Timeboxing
o.C: Work-in-progress limits
o.D: Sprint review

items.exEn: XP principles include humanity, economics, mutual benefit, self-similarity, improvement, diversity, reflection, flow, opportunity, redundancy, failure, quality, baby steps and accepted responsibility.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ أحد مبادئ Extreme Programming (XP)؟
items.exAr: من مبادئ XP: الإنسانية، والاقتصاد، والمنفعة المتبادلة، والتحسين، والتنوع، والتأمل، والتدفق، والجودة، والخطوات الصغيرة (baby steps)، وتحمّل المسؤولية.

items.q: An XP team notices that the automatic build and test run takes 40 minutes, so developers stop running it before committing. Which XP practice should they aim to restore?

o.A: Pair programming
o.B: Ten-minute build
o.C: Whole team
o.D: Weekly cycle

items.exEn: The ten-minute build practice keeps the automated build and tests fast enough to run frequently.
items.qAr: لاحظ فريق XP أن الـ build التلقائي مع تشغيل الاختبارات يستغرق 40 دقيقة، فتوقف المطورون عن تشغيله قبل الـ commit. أي ممارسة من ممارسات XP يجب أن يسعى الفريق لاستعادتها؟
items.exAr: ممارسة الـ ten-minute build تُبقي الـ build والاختبارات التلقائية سريعة بما يكفي لتشغيلها بشكل متكرر.

items.q: Which set contains only XP values?

o.A: Commitment, focus, openness, respect, courage
o.B: Transparency, inspection, adaptation, respect, feedback
o.C: Communication, simplicity, feedback, courage, respect
o.D: Visualization, flow, pull, simplicity, courage

items.exEn: XP defines five values: communication, simplicity, feedback, courage and respect.
items.qAr: أي مجموعة تحتوي على قيم XP فقط؟
items.exAr: يحدد XP خمس قيم: التواصل، والبساطة، والـ feedback، والشجاعة، والاحترام.

items.q: How does Scrum define the role of the tester?

o.A: The tester is a separate fourth role in the Scrum team
o.B: The tester reports to the scrum master
o.C: The tester is part of the product owner role
o.D: Scrum does not define a tester role; testers are members of the development team

items.exEn: Scrum defines product owner, scrum master and development team; testing skills are part of the cross-functional team.
items.qAr: كيف يحدد Scrum دور المختبر؟
items.exAr: يحدد Scrum دور الـ product owner والـ scrum master والـ development team فقط، ومهارات الاختبار جزء من الفريق متعدد التخصصات.

items.q: In Scrum, what is the sprint backlog?

o.A: The set of product backlog items the team selects for the sprint, together with the tasks to deliver them
o.B: The list of defects found during the previous sprint
o.C: The complete, prioritized list of all planned product items
o.D: The product owner's list of items for the next release only

items.exEn: At sprint planning the team selects items from the product backlog into the sprint backlog and breaks them into tasks.
items.qAr: في Scrum، ما هو الـ sprint backlog؟
items.exAr: في الـ sprint planning يختار الفريق عناصر من الـ product backlog إلى الـ sprint backlog ويقسّمها إلى مهام.

items.q: On the last day of a sprint, a story has been coded and unit tested, but its acceptance tests have not been executed. The team's definition of done requires passed acceptance tests. What should happen to the story?

o.A: It is counted as done because the code is complete
o.B: It is not considered done and is not part of the increment; it returns to the product backlog for re-prioritization
o.C: The sprint is extended until the acceptance tests pass
o.D: The definition of done is changed for this sprint so the story can be accepted

items.exEn: A story that does not meet the definition of done is not done and goes back to the product backlog.
items.qAr: في اليوم الأخير من الـ sprint، تمت برمجة قصة وإجراء unit testing لها، لكن لم يتم تنفيذ اختبارات القبول. الـ definition of done لدى الفريق يتطلب نجاح اختبارات القبول. ماذا يجب أن يحدث للقصة؟
items.exAr: القصة التي لا تحقق الـ definition of done لا تُعدّ منجزة وتعود إلى الـ product backlog.

items.q: In Scrum, how is transparency supported on a daily basis?

o.A: By the product owner approving each task
o.B: By the scrum master writing a weekly status report
o.C: By the development team reporting and updating sprint status at the daily scrum
o.D: By the customer reviewing the code every day

items.exEn: The development team reports and updates sprint status daily at the daily scrum, making progress visible.
items.qAr: في Scrum، كيف يتم دعم الشفافية بشكل يومي؟
items.exAr: يعرض الـ development team حالة الـ sprint ويحدّثها يومياً في الـ daily scrum فيصبح التقدم مرئياً للجميع.

items.q: What is the typical length of a sprint in Scrum?

o.A: One day
o.B: Exactly three months
o.C: Usually between two and four weeks
o.D: Variable, decided per story

items.exEn: CTFL-AT describes sprints as fixed-length iterations, usually two to four weeks.
items.qAr: ما المدة المعتادة للـ sprint في Scrum؟
items.exAr: يصف منهج CTFL-AT الـ sprints بأنها iterations ذات مدة ثابتة، عادةً من أسبوعين إلى أربعة أسابيع.

items.q: In Kanban, what is the team trying to optimize when it focuses on lead time?

o.A: The number of columns on the Kanban board
o.B: The duration of each daily meeting
o.C: The number of items each team member works on at once
o.D: The time from when an item enters the flow until it is delivered, to achieve a continuous flow

items.exEn: Kanban optimizes the continuous flow of tasks by minimizing the (average) lead time of the complete value stream.
items.qAr: في Kanban، ما الذي يحاول الفريق تحسينه عندما يركّز على الـ lead time؟
items.exAr: يسعى Kanban إلى تدفق مستمر للمهام عبر تقليل متوسط الـ lead time لسلسلة القيمة كاملة.

items.q: A Kanban board has a WIP limit of 3 in the 'Testing' column, and 3 items are already being tested. A developer finishes another item. What should happen next according to Kanban?

o.A: The developer moves the item into 'Testing' anyway, so it is not forgotten
o.B: The item waits in the development 'done' area; the developer can help testers finish an item so a new one can be pulled
o.C: The WIP limit is increased to 4 for this item
o.D: The item is released to production without testing

items.exEn: Kanban is a pull system: a new item is pulled only when capacity is free; helping clear the bottleneck is preferred over exceeding the limit.
