items.qAr: لوحة Kanban فيها WIP limit يساوي 3 في عمود «Testing»، ويوجد حالياً 3 عناصر قيد الاختبار. أنهى أحد المطورين عنصراً آخر. ماذا يجب أن يحدث بعد ذلك وفقاً لـ Kanban؟
items.exAr: Kanban نظام سحب (pull): لا يُسحب عنصر جديد إلا عند توفر سعة، ومساعدة الفريق على إزالة الاختناق أفضل من تجاوز الحد.

items.q: What is the main purpose of the Kanban board?

o.A: To visualize the value chain and the state of each work item as it moves through the activities
o.B: To record the effort estimates of each story
o.C: To list the defects found in production
o.D: To replace the product backlog

items.exEn: The Kanban board visualizes the value chain, with columns for stations/activities and items moving from left to right.
items.qAr: ما الغرض الرئيسي من لوحة Kanban؟
items.exAr: تعرض لوحة Kanban سلسلة القيمة بشكل مرئي، حيث تمثل الأعمدة الأنشطة وتتحرك العناصر من اليسار إلى اليمين.

items.q: During backlog refinement, the team finds that the story 'As a customer, I want to manage my whole account online' cannot be completed within one sprint. Which INVEST characteristic does the story fail?

o.A: Independent
o.B: Negotiable
o.C: Valuable
o.D: Small

items.exEn: A story too large to finish in one iteration violates 'Small' and should be split.
items.qAr: أثناء الـ backlog refinement، وجد الفريق أن القصة «بصفتي عميلاً، أريد إدارة حسابي بالكامل عبر الإنترنت» لا يمكن إنجازها خلال sprint واحد. أي خاصية من خصائص INVEST لا تحققها القصة؟
items.exAr: القصة الأكبر من أن تُنجز في iteration واحد تخالف خاصية Small ويجب تقسيمها.

items.q: A tester and the product owner agree that the story 'Reset password' is accepted when a reset link is e-mailed within one minute and expires after 24 hours. Which of the three C's does this agreement represent?

o.A: Card
o.B: Conversation
o.C: Confirmation
o.D: Collaboration

items.exEn: Confirmation is the set of acceptance criteria that confirm the story is done.
items.qAr: اتفق مختبر مع الـ product owner على أن القصة «إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور» تُقبل عندما يُرسل رابط إعادة التعيين بالبريد خلال دقيقة واحدة وتنتهي صلاحيته بعد 24 ساعة. أي من الـ three C's يمثله هذا الاتفاق؟
items.exAr: الـ Confirmation هي معايير القبول التي تؤكد أن القصة منجزة.

items.q: Which techniques does the CTFL-AT syllabus mention as useful for collaboratively creating user stories?

o.A: Boundary value analysis and decision tables
o.B: Brainstorming and mind maps
o.C: Code reviews and static analysis
o.D: Load testing and profiling

items.exEn: Techniques such as brainstorming and mind maps can be used in collaborative user story writing.
items.qAr: ما التقنيات التي يذكرها منهج CTFL-AT كتقنيات مفيدة لإنشاء الـ user stories بشكل تعاوني؟
items.exAr: يمكن استخدام تقنيات مثل العصف الذهني (brainstorming) والخرائط الذهنية (mind maps) في الكتابة التعاونية للـ user stories.

items.q: Which statement about user stories in Agile projects is correct?

o.A: User stories should cover only functional behaviour; non-functional requirements belong in a separate document
o.B: User stories are written by the product owner alone and handed to the testers
o.C: User stories should address both functional and non-functional characteristics, each with acceptance criteria
o.D: User stories do not need acceptance criteria if they are small

items.exEn: Stories should address functional and non-functional characteristics and include acceptance criteria.
items.qAr: أي عبارة عن الـ user stories في مشاريع Agile صحيحة؟
items.exAr: يجب أن تتناول الـ user stories الخصائص الوظيفية وغير الوظيفية، ولكل منها معايير قبول.

items.q: Which of the following topics can be addressed in a retrospective?

o.A: Only the defects found during the iteration
o.B: Only the technical tools used by developers
o.C: Only the performance of individual team members, for appraisal purposes
o.D: Process, people, organizations, relationships and tools

items.exEn: Retrospectives can cover process, people, organizations, relationships and tools.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يمكن تناوله في الـ retrospective؟
items.exAr: يمكن أن يتناول الـ retrospective العملية والأشخاص والمؤسسات والعلاقات والأدوات.

items.q: In a retrospective, the tester points out that many defects were found late because stories reached testing only on the last two days of each sprint. The team agrees to finish and hand over stories continuously. What does this illustrate about the tester's role in retrospectives?

o.A: Testers bring a unique perspective and help identify test-related and process improvements
o.B: Testers should only report defect counts in retrospectives
o.C: Testers decide alone which process changes the team adopts
o.D: Retrospectives are where defects are assigned to developers

items.exEn: Testers play an important role by bringing their testing perspective and proposing improvements for the whole team.
items.qAr: في أحد الـ retrospectives، أشار المختبر إلى أن كثيراً من الـ defects اكتُشفت متأخرة لأن القصص كانت تصل للاختبار في آخر يومين من كل sprint فقط، فاتفق الفريق على إنهاء القصص وتسليمها بشكل مستمر. ماذا يوضح هذا عن دور المختبر في الـ retrospectives؟
items.exAr: يؤدي المختبرون دوراً مهماً عبر تقديم منظور الاختبار واقتراح تحسينات للفريق بأكمله.

items.q: Which condition is most important for a retrospective to be effective?

o.A: The project manager leads the session and assigns blame for failures
o.B: A professional environment of mutual trust where team members can speak openly without blame
o.C: Results are kept confidential and not followed up
o.D: It is held only at the end of the release

items.exEn: Retrospectives need mutual trust and a blame-free setting, and improvements must be followed up.
items.qAr: ما الشرط الأهم ليكون الـ retrospective فعّالاً؟
items.exAr: يحتاج الـ retrospective إلى ثقة متبادلة وبيئة خالية من اللوم، مع متابعة التحسينات المتفق عليها.

items.q: A team refactors a core module several times per sprint. Why does continuous integration reduce the risk of this refactoring?

o.A: Because refactored code no longer needs unit tests
o.B: Because CI postpones integration until the refactoring is finished
o.C: Because automated regression tests run with every integration, quickly revealing anything the refactoring broke
o.D: Because CI replaces code reviews

items.exEn: CI reduces regression risk from refactoring through rapid automated re-testing after each change.
items.qAr: يقوم فريق بإعادة هيكلة (refactoring) لوحدة أساسية عدة مرات في كل sprint. لماذا يقلل الـ continuous integration من خطر هذا الـ refactoring؟
items.exAr: يقلل الـ CI خطر الـ regression الناتج عن الـ refactoring عبر إعادة الاختبار التلقائي السريع بعد كل تغيير.

items.q: A CI build fails after a developer's commit, but the team decides to keep committing new code and fix the build at the end of the week. What is the main consequence?

o.A: Defects accumulate and become harder to isolate, losing the fast feedback that CI provides
o.B: Nothing, because CI results are only relevant before release
o.C: Test coverage automatically increases
o.D: The build server will repair the failure itself

items.exEn: CI gives value only if failures are fixed quickly; delaying makes defects pile up and harder to locate.
items.qAr: فشل الـ build في الـ CI بعد commit من أحد المطورين، لكن الفريق قرر الاستمرار في إضافة كود جديد وإصلاح الـ build في نهاية الأسبوع. ما النتيجة الرئيسية؟
items.exAr: قيمة الـ CI في الـ feedback السريع، وتأجيل الإصلاح يجعل الـ defects تتراكم ويصعب تحديد مصدرها.

items.q: Which activity is a typical tester contribution during release planning?

o.A: Executing the regression suite for the current sprint
o.B: Writing the daily scrum notes
o.C: Breaking a single story into detailed coding tasks
o.D: Participating in project and quality risk analysis and estimating the testing effort for the release

items.exEn: In release planning testers help write testable stories, take part in risk analysis, estimate test effort and plan testing for the release.
items.qAr: أي نشاط يُعدّ مساهمة نموذجية للمختبر خلال الـ release planning؟
items.exAr: في الـ release planning يساعد المختبرون في كتابة قصص قابلة للاختبار، ويشاركون في تحليل المخاطر، ويقدّرون جهد الاختبار، ويخططون للاختبار على مستوى الإصدار.

items.q: During iteration planning, a story says 'The report must load quickly.' Which action best reflects the tester's role at this point?

o.A: Accept the story and decide on performance criteria after the sprint
o.B: Ask questions to make the story testable, for example agreeing a measurable response time, and include the testing tasks in the estimate
o.C: Remove the story from the iteration because non-functional requirements are not tested in Agile
o.D: Wait until the developer finishes coding before analysing the story

items.exEn: In iteration planning testers check testability, clarify functional and non-functional aspects, break stories into testing tasks and estimate testing effort.
items.qAr: خلال الـ iteration planning، تنص إحدى القصص على أن «التقرير يجب أن يُحمّل بسرعة». أي إجراء يعكس دور المختبر في هذه المرحلة بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: في الـ iteration planning يتحقق المختبرون من قابلية الاختبار، ويوضحون الجوانب الوظيفية وغير الوظيفية، ويقسّمون القصص إلى مهام اختبار ويقدّرون جهدها.

items.q: Some Agile teams use hardening (stabilization) iterations. What is the main purpose of such an iteration?

o.A: To develop the highest-priority new features before the release
o.B: To resolve lingering defects and other forms of technical debt
o.C: To write the detailed master test plan for the next release
o.D: To replace the regression testing performed in earlier iterations

items.exEn: Hardening or stabilization iterations are used to clear remaining defects and technical debt.
items.qAr: تستخدم بعض فرق Agile ما يُسمّى hardening (أو stabilization) iterations. ما الهدف الرئيسي من هذا النوع من الـ iterations؟
items.exAr: تُستخدم الـ hardening iterations لمعالجة الـ defects المتبقية وأشكال الـ technical debt الأخرى.

items.q: A team plans to postpone the integration and system testing of all user stories to a single hardening iteration at the end of the release. According to good Agile practice, what is the main concern with this plan?

o.A: Hardening iterations are not allowed in any Agile framework
o.B: Integration testing must always be performed by an independent test team
o.C: A feature should not be considered done until it has been integrated and tested with the system
o.D: System testing should only be performed by the product owner

items.exEn: Best practice is that no feature is done until it is integrated and tested with the system, so deferring this to a hardening iteration is risky.
items.qAr: يخطط فريق لتأجيل الـ integration testing والـ system testing لكل الـ user stories إلى hardening iteration واحدة في نهاية الـ release. وفقاً للممارسات الجيدة في Agile، ما المشكلة الرئيسية في هذه الخطة؟
items.exAr: الممارسة الأفضل أن أي feature لا تُعتبر done قبل دمجها واختبارها مع النظام، لذا تأجيل ذلك إلى hardening iteration يزيد المخاطر.

items.q: At the end of an iteration, three defects in stories delivered during that iteration are still open. Which approach is a recommended good practice?

o.A: Address them at the beginning of the next iteration as part of that iteration's backlog
o.B: Leave them for a hardening iteration at the end of the release
o.C: Close them and re-open them only if customers report them
o.D: Extend the current iteration until all of them are fixed

items.exEn: A good practice ('fix bugs first') is to handle defects left from the previous iteration at the start of the next one, as part of its backlog.
items.qAr: في نهاية iteration ما، بقيت ثلاثة defects مفتوحة في stories تم تسليمها خلال تلك الـ iteration. ما الأسلوب الموصى به كممارسة جيدة؟
items.exAr: من الممارسات الجيدة (fix bugs first) معالجة الـ defects المتبقية من الـ iteration السابقة في بداية الـ iteration التالية كجزء من الـ backlog الخاص بها.

items.q: Why does a higher percentage of manual testing in Agile projects tend to rely on experience-based and defect-based techniques such as exploratory testing, software attacks and error guessing?

o.A: Because Agile projects have no requirements of any kind
o.B: Because black-box test techniques are not permitted in Agile projects
o.C: Because the product owner selects all test techniques for the team
o.D: Because heavy use of test automation already covers many of the scripted, repeatable checks

items.exEn: With heavy automation handling repeatable checks, the remaining manual testing focuses on experience-based and defect-based techniques.
items.qAr: لماذا تميل نسبة أكبر من الـ manual testing في مشاريع Agile إلى استخدام experience-based techniques وdefect-based techniques مثل exploratory testing وsoftware attacks وerror guessing؟
items.exAr: لأن الاعتماد الكبير على الـ test automation يغطي كثيراً من الفحوصات المتكررة، فيتركز الـ manual testing المتبقي على هذه التقنيات.

items.q: In many Agile teams that automate tests at all levels, how is the creation of automated tests typically divided?

o.A: Testers write all automated tests while developers only fix defects
o.B: Only a separate automation team outside the Agile team writes automated tests
o.C: Developers focus on automated unit tests, while testers focus on automated integration, system and system integration tests
o.D: Developers automate the acceptance tests, while testers write the unit tests

items.exEn: Developers concentrate on unit tests; testers concentrate on automating integration, system and system integration tests.
items.qAr: في كثير من فرق Agile التي تطبق الـ test automation على كل المستويات، كيف يُقسَّم عادةً إنشاء الـ automated tests؟
items.exAr: يركز الـ developers على الـ unit tests، بينما يركز الـ testers على أتمتة الـ integration tests والـ system tests والـ system integration tests.

items.q: Because of the heavy use of test automation in Agile projects, which kind of tester do Agile teams tend to favor?

o.A: Testers with a strong technical and test automation background
o.B: Testers who focus only on writing detailed manual test scripts
o.C: Testers who mainly review documents and do not execute tests
o.D: Testers who join the project only for the final acceptance phase

items.exEn: Heavy automation leads Agile teams to favor testers with strong technical and automation skills.
items.qAr: بسبب الاستخدام الكبير للـ test automation في مشاريع Agile، أي نوع من الـ testers تميل فرق Agile إلى تفضيله؟
items.exAr: الاعتماد الكبير على الأتمتة يجعل فرق Agile تفضّل الـ testers أصحاب الخلفية التقنية القوية والخبرة في الـ test automation.

items.q: In every iteration, the product owner requests many changes to existing features. The team relies on automated regression tests to keep the extra test effort under control. Which caution applies in this situation?

o.A: Automated tests make the rate of change irrelevant to the team
o.B: Changes to existing features do not need to be retested
o.C: Changes should be accepted only during a hardening iteration
o.D: The rate of change should not exceed the team's ability to deal with the risks associated with those changes

items.exEn: Automation helps manage the test effort caused by change, but the rate of change must not exceed the team's capacity to handle its risks.
items.qAr: في كل iteration يطلب الـ product owner تغييرات كثيرة على features موجودة، ويعتمد الفريق على automated regression tests للسيطرة على جهد الاختبار الإضافي. ما التحذير الذي ينطبق في هذا الموقف؟
items.exAr: الأتمتة تساعد في إدارة جهد الاختبار الناتج عن التغيير، لكن يجب ألا يتجاوز معدل التغيير قدرة الفريق على التعامل مع مخاطره.

items.q: Why do Agile projects favor lightweight work product documentation?

o.A: Because Agile teams do not need any test work products
o.B: Because change may occur throughout the project, making heavy documentation costly to keep up to date
o.C: Because documentation is the sole responsibility of the customer
o.D: Because tools automatically generate all the required documentation

items.exEn: A core Agile principle is that change can happen at any time, so lightweight documentation is preferred.
items.qAr: لماذا تفضّل مشاريع Agile التوثيق الخفيف (lightweight) للـ work products؟
items.exAr: من المبادئ الأساسية في Agile أن التغيير قد يحدث طوال المشروع، لذلك يُفضَّل التوثيق الخفيف بدل التوثيق الثقيل المكلف في التحديث.

items.q: Into which category of Agile project work products does a database design (for example, an entity-relationship diagram) fall?

o.A: Business-oriented work products
o.B: Test work products
o.C: Customer acceptance work products
o.D: Development work products

items.exEn: Specifications describing how the system is built, such as database designs, are development work products.
items.qAr: إلى أي فئة من فئات الـ work products في مشاريع Agile ينتمي تصميم قاعدة البيانات (مثل entity-relationship diagram)؟
items.exAr: المواصفات التي تصف كيف يُبنى النظام، مثل تصميم قاعدة البيانات، تُعتبر development work products.

items.q: In which situation is an Agile team most likely to need more formal and detailed documentation than usual?

o.A: The team is co-located with the business representatives
o.B: The product is developed for a regulated domain where audits require documented evidence
o.C: The team uses continuous integration for every check-in
o.D: The team estimates user stories using planning poker

items.exEn: Regulated or safety-critical contexts can require more formal documentation even in Agile projects.
items.qAr: في أي موقف يُرجَّح أن يحتاج فريق Agile إلى توثيق أكثر رسمية وتفصيلاً من المعتاد؟
items.exAr: البيئات الخاضعة للتنظيم أو ذات الأمان الحرج قد تتطلب توثيقاً أكثر رسمية حتى في مشاريع Agile.

items.q: Compared with traditional projects, which work products receive the strongest emphasis in Agile projects?

o.A: Comprehensive requirements specifications signed off before coding
o.B: Detailed test plans written for every test level
o.C: Working software and automated tests
o.D: Formal phase-exit reports for each development phase

items.exEn: Agile projects emphasize working software and automated tests over extensive documentation.
items.qAr: مقارنةً بالمشاريع التقليدية، أي الـ work products تحظى بالتركيز الأكبر في مشاريع Agile؟
items.exAr: تركز مشاريع Agile على البرمجية العاملة والـ automated tests أكثر من التوثيق المكثف.

items.q: An Agile team produces the following work products: (i) user documentation, (ii) automated unit tests, (iii) a quality risk catalog. Which option classifies them correctly?

o.A: (i) business-oriented, (ii) development, (iii) test
o.B: (i) development, (ii) test, (iii) business-oriented
o.C: (i) business-oriented, (ii) test, (iii) development
o.D: (i) test, (ii) development, (iii) business-oriented

items.exEn: User documentation is business-oriented, automated unit tests are created by developers as development work products, and a quality risk catalog is a test work product.
items.qAr: ينتج فريق Agile الـ work products التالية: (i) user documentation، (ii) automated unit tests، (iii) quality risk catalog. أي خيار يصنّفها بشكل صحيح؟
items.exAr: الـ user documentation من فئة business-oriented، والـ automated unit tests يكتبها الـ developers كـ development work products، والـ quality risk catalog من الـ test work products.

items.q: For a single user story within an iteration, which sequence of test activities is typical in an Agile project?

o.A: Unit testing → feature verification → feature validation
o.B: Feature validation → unit testing → feature verification
o.C: Feature verification → feature validation → unit testing
o.D: Unit testing → feature validation → feature verification

items.exEn: A story is first unit tested, then feature acceptance testing follows: verification against acceptance criteria, then validation with stakeholders.
items.qAr: بالنسبة لـ user story واحدة داخل iteration، ما التسلسل المعتاد لأنشطة الاختبار في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: تُختبر الـ story أولاً بالـ unit testing، ثم يأتي الـ feature acceptance testing: الـ verification مقابل معايير القبول ثم الـ validation مع أصحاب المصلحة.

items.q: During an iteration, a regression testing process runs in parallel with the testing of the new user stories. What does this process usually consist of?

o.A: Manual retesting of all features by the product owner at the end of the release
o.B: Exploratory testing sessions limited to the newest user stories
o.C: Re-running only the acceptance tests of the previous release once per quarter
o.D: Re-running the automated unit tests and feature verification tests from the current and previous iterations, usually via continuous integration

items.exEn: Parallel regression testing re-runs automated unit and feature verification tests from current and earlier iterations, typically through CI.
items.qAr: خلال الـ iteration، تعمل عملية regression testing بالتوازي مع اختبار الـ user stories الجديدة. مِمّ تتكون هذه العملية عادةً؟
items.exAr: الـ regression testing الموازي يعيد تشغيل الـ automated unit tests والـ feature verification tests من الـ iteration الحالية والسابقة، غالباً عبر الـ continuous integration.

items.q: When can alpha and beta tests take place in an Agile project?

o.A: Only after the final iteration of the release has finished
o.B: At the close of each iteration, after each iteration, or after a series of iterations
o.C: Only before the first iteration begins
o.D: Only during a dedicated hardening iteration

items.exEn: Internal alpha and external beta tests may occur at the close of each iteration, after each iteration, or after a series of iterations.
items.qAr: متى يمكن إجراء الـ alpha tests والـ beta tests في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: يمكن إجراء الـ alpha والـ beta tests في نهاية كل iteration، أو بعد كل iteration، أو بعد سلسلة من الـ iterations.

items.q: A product must undergo system integration testing with several external partner systems, and this testing cannot fit within a single sprint. Who might typically handle such work?

o.A: The product owner during the sprint review
o.B: The developers as part of their unit testing
o.C: Specialized testers outside the Agile team who work on longer-term, non-iteration activities
o.D: The Scrum Master during the retrospective

items.exEn: Specialized testers outside the team may handle long-term activities and test levels that do not fit well within a sprint, such as system integration testing.
items.qAr: يجب أن يخضع منتج لـ system integration testing مع عدة أنظمة خارجية للشركاء، ولا يمكن إنجاز هذا الاختبار داخل sprint واحد. من الذي قد يتولى هذا العمل عادةً؟
items.exAr: قد يتولى testers متخصصون من خارج الفريق الأنشطة طويلة المدى ومستويات الاختبار التي لا تتناسب مع الـ sprint مثل الـ system integration testing.

items.q: On some Agile projects there is a system test level. When does it typically begin?

o.A: Only after all iterations of the release are finished
o.B: Once the first user story is ready for such testing
o.C: Before any unit testing has been performed
o.D: Only after user acceptance testing has been completed

items.exEn: In some Agile projects, system testing begins once the first user story is ready for it, and runs functional and non-functional tests.
items.qAr: في بعض مشاريع Agile يوجد مستوى system test. متى يبدأ عادةً؟
items.exAr: في بعض مشاريع Agile يبدأ الـ system testing بمجرد أن تصبح أول user story جاهزة لهذا النوع من الاختبار، ويشمل اختبارات functional وnon-functional.

items.q: In an Agile project, where should automated tests and manual test work products be stored?

o.A: On each tester's local machine
o.B: In e-mail attachments sent to the product owner
o.C: In the same configuration management repository as the product source code
o.D: Only inside the defect management tool

items.exEn: Agile teams keep automated tests and manual test work products under configuration management, in the same repository as the source code.
items.qAr: في مشروع Agile، أين يجب حفظ الـ automated tests والـ manual test work products؟
items.exAr: تحفظ فرق Agile الـ automated tests والـ test work products اليدوية تحت الـ configuration management في نفس الـ repository الخاص بالـ source code.

items.q: A developer has completed a small change and is about to check it into the mainline of the configuration management system. What should happen first?

o.A: A tester should write a detailed test plan for the change
o.B: The product owner should review and approve the code
o.C: The change should be held until the hardening iteration
o.D: The automated unit tests should be run, and the change checked in only if they pass

items.exEn: Automated unit tests are run before source code is checked into the mainline, to confirm the change did not break the build.
items.qAr: أنهى developer تعديلاً صغيراً وهو على وشك إدخاله (check in) إلى الـ mainline في نظام الـ configuration management. ما الذي يجب أن يحدث أولاً؟
items.exAr: تُشغَّل الـ automated unit tests قبل إدخال الـ source code إلى الـ mainline للتأكد من أن التعديل لم يكسر الـ build.

items.q: After several check-ins, the automated build and test process reports that some automated system tests have failed. Which response best fits Agile practice?

o.A: Make the results visible to the team and fix the cause quickly so the build is healthy again
o.B: Ignore the failures until the end of the iteration
o.C: Remove the failing tests from the automated suite
o.D: Switch off the automated builds until the sprint review

items.exEn: Automated build and test results are visible to the whole team, and failures are addressed quickly to keep the build working.
items.qAr: بعد عدة check-ins، أظهرت عملية الـ automated build and test فشل بعض الـ automated system tests. ما الاستجابة الأنسب لممارسات Agile؟
items.exAr: نتائج الـ automated build and test تكون مرئية للفريق كله، ويُعالج الفشل بسرعة حتى يعود الـ build سليماً.

items.q: Besides automated unit tests, which tests can be included in an Agile team's automated build and test process?

o.A: Only static reviews of user stories
o.B: Only manual exploratory testing sessions
o.C: Functional and non-functional tests at the integration and system levels
o.D: Only user acceptance tests executed by customers

items.exEn: Automated tests in CI can include functional and non-functional tests at integration and system levels, not only unit tests.
items.qAr: إلى جانب الـ automated unit tests، ما الاختبارات التي يمكن تضمينها في عملية الـ automated build and test لدى فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: يمكن أن تشمل الاختبارات المؤتمتة في الـ CI اختبارات functional وnon-functional على مستويي الـ integration والـ system، وليس الـ unit tests فقط.

items.q: An organization assigns testers from a separate test team to its Agile teams on demand, only at the end of each sprint. Which problem is most likely with this option?

o.A: Time pressure, limited understanding of the new features, and weaker relationships with developers and business stakeholders
o.B: The testers lose all independence and objectivity
o.C: The developers can no longer write automated unit tests
o.D: The Agile teams can no longer use continuous integration

items.exEn: On-demand testers at sprint end keep independence but often face time pressure, poor understanding of new features and relationship issues.
items.qAr: تُسند مؤسسة testers من test team مستقل إلى فرق Agile حسب الطلب، وفقط في نهاية كل sprint. ما المشكلة الأكثر احتمالاً في هذا الخيار؟
items.exAr: الـ testers المستدعون حسب الطلب في نهاية الـ sprint يحافظون على الاستقلالية، لكنهم يواجهون غالباً ضغط الوقت وضعف فهم الـ features الجديدة ومشكلات في العلاقة مع الفريق وأصحاب المصلحة.

items.q: A company wants its testers to stay independent while also gaining a good understanding of the product and strong relationships with the other team members. Which organizational option best meets this goal?

o.A: Testers from an independent test team called in on demand at the end of each sprint
o.B: No testers at all, with developers performing every test
o.C: Testers rotated to a different Agile team every day
o.D: Testers from an independent test team assigned to Agile teams on a long-term basis from the start of the project

items.exEn: Long-term assignment of independent testers from the project's start preserves independence while building product knowledge and relationships.
items.qAr: تريد شركة أن يحافظ الـ testers لديها على استقلاليتهم، وفي الوقت نفسه يكتسبون فهماً جيداً للمنتج وعلاقات قوية مع بقية أعضاء الفريق. أي خيار تنظيمي يحقق هذا الهدف بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: إسناد testers من فريق مستقل إلى فرق Agile على المدى الطويل منذ بداية المشروع يحافظ على الاستقلالية ويبني فهم المنتج والعلاقات.

items.q: In an Agile iteration, who is expected to test the product?

o.A: Only the testers in the team
o.B: Testers, developers and business stakeholders
o.C: Only an independent test team at the end of the release
o.D: Only the customer during acceptance

items.exEn: In Agile, testers, developers and business stakeholders all have a role in testing the product throughout the iteration.
items.qAr: في الـ iteration ضمن Agile، من المتوقع أن يختبر المنتج؟
items.exAr: في Agile يشارك الـ testers والـ developers وأصحاب المصلحة من جهة الأعمال جميعاً في اختبار المنتج خلال الـ iteration.

items.q: A team committed to 60 story points for a 10-working-day iteration. At the end of day 5, the iteration burndown chart shows 45 story points remaining. Assuming the ideal line falls evenly from 60 to 0, what does the chart indicate?

o.A: The team is 15 story points ahead of the ideal line
o.B: The team is exactly on track
o.C: The team is 15 story points behind the ideal line, so completing the commitment is at risk
o.D: The team is 45 story points behind the ideal line

items.exEn: Ideal remaining after 5 of 10 days is 60 × 5/10 = 30; 45 − 30 = 15 points behind.
items.qAr: التزم فريق بـ 60 story points في iteration مدتها 10 أيام عمل. في نهاية اليوم الخامس يُظهر الـ burndown chart أن المتبقي 45 story points. بافتراض أن الخط المثالي ينخفض بانتظام من 60 إلى 0، ماذا يشير الـ chart؟
items.exAr: المتبقي المثالي بعد 5 من 10 أيام هو 60 × 5/10 = 30، و45 − 30 = 15، أي أن الفريق متأخر بـ 15 نقطة.

items.q: In the last three iterations a team completed 18, 22 and 20 story points. The remaining release backlog is estimated at 100 story points. Using the average velocity, how many more iterations are needed to complete the release backlog?
items.exEn: Average velocity = (18 + 22 + 20) / 3 = 20 points; 100 / 20 = 5 iterations.
items.qAr: أنجز فريق في آخر ثلاث iterations ما مجموعه 18 و22 و20 story points. والمتبقي من الـ release backlog مُقدَّر بـ 100 story points. باستخدام متوسط الـ velocity، كم iteration إضافية يحتاجها الفريق لإنهاء الـ release backlog؟
items.exAr: متوسط الـ velocity = (18 + 22 + 20) / 3 = 20 نقطة، و100 / 20 = 5 iterations.

items.q: On the second-to-last day of an iteration, the task board shows user story S-7 as follows: all coding tasks are in 'Done'; 'Automate acceptance tests' and 'Exploratory session' are in 'To Do'; 'Prepare test data' is in 'In Progress' and marked as blocked. What is the correct interpretation?

o.A: S-7 is not done; the blocker should be raised at the daily stand-up and the team should help finish the testing tasks
o.B: S-7 is done because all coding tasks are complete
o.C: S-7 can be shown in the iteration review because only testing tasks remain
o.D: S-7 should be moved to the next iteration without informing the team

items.exEn: A story is done only when all its tasks, including testing tasks, are complete; blockers are raised at the stand-up so the whole team can help.
items.qAr: في اليوم قبل الأخير من الـ iteration يُظهر الـ task board الـ user story S-7 كالتالي: كل مهام البرمجة في 'Done'، ومهمتا 'أتمتة acceptance tests' و'Exploratory session' في 'To Do'، ومهمة 'تجهيز test data' في 'In Progress' وعليها علامة blocked. ما التفسير الصحيح؟
items.exAr: الـ story لا تُعدّ منجزة إلا عند اكتمال كل مهامها بما فيها مهام الاختبار، والعوائق تُطرح في الـ stand-up ليساعد الفريق كله.

items.q: A team's iteration burndown chart stays almost flat for the first eight days and then drops sharply on the last two days. What is the MOST likely explanation?

o.A: The team estimated the stories too low during planning poker
o.B: The product owner added new stories in the middle of the iteration
o.C: The team has finished the iteration ahead of schedule
o.D: Stories are coded early but tested and completed only at the end, creating a mini-waterfall inside the iteration

items.exEn: A flat line followed by a late drop typically means work items are not being finished (including testing) incrementally during the iteration.
items.qAr: يبقى الـ burndown chart الخاص بفريق شبه مستوٍ خلال الأيام الثمانية الأولى، ثم ينخفض بحدة في اليومين الأخيرين. ما التفسير الأرجح؟
items.exAr: الخط المستوي ثم الهبوط المتأخر يعني عادةً أن العمل، ومنه الاختبار، لا يُنجز تدريجياً بل يُكدَّس في نهاية الـ iteration كـ mini-waterfall.

items.q: Which set of metrics is MOST suitable for communicating product quality in an Agile project?

o.A: Test pass/fail rates, defect discovery rates, and requirements and risk coverage
o.B: Hours logged by testers, number of stand-ups held, and team size
o.C: Number of story points estimated in planning poker
o.D: Number of user stories written by the product owner

items.exEn: Product quality is commonly communicated through test results, defect trends and coverage of requirements and risks (plus customer feedback).
items.qAr: أي مجموعة من المقاييس هي الأنسب لإيصال جودة المنتج في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: جودة المنتج تُوصَل عادةً عبر نتائج الاختبار واتجاهات الـ defects وتغطية المتطلبات والمخاطر، إضافةً إلى ملاحظات العملاء.

items.q: A team publishes the results of its automated builds and tests on a wiki dashboard that is updated automatically after each run. What is the main benefit of this practice?

o.A: It removes the need for the daily stand-up meeting
o.B: It makes test status transparent to the whole team and stakeholders at any time without testers having to produce manual reports
o.C: It allows the product owner to approve each test case
o.D: It replaces the need for a definition of done

items.exEn: Automatically updated dashboards give continuous, transparent status information and free testers from manual reporting.
items.qAr: ينشر فريق نتائج الـ builds والاختبارات المؤتمتة على wiki dashboard يتحدّث تلقائياً بعد كل تشغيل. ما الفائدة الرئيسية من هذه الممارسة؟
items.exAr: الـ dashboards التي تتحدث تلقائياً تمنح الفريق والمعنيين رؤية شفافة ومستمرة للحالة وتُغني المختبِرين عن إعداد تقارير يدوية.

items.q: At which levels can burndown charts be used in an Agile project?

o.A: Only within a single iteration
o.B: Only for the whole project budget
o.C: Only to track the number of defects
o.D: Both within each iteration and across the entire release

items.exEn: Burndown charts can show progress within each iteration and across the whole release.
items.qAr: على أي مستويات يمكن استخدام الـ burndown charts في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: يمكن للـ burndown charts أن تعرض التقدم داخل كل iteration وعلى مستوى الـ release كاملاً.

items.q: In iteration 6, the product owner changes a discount rule that was implemented in iteration 2. After the change is coded, several automated regression tests fail because they still check the old rule. What should the tester do FIRST?

o.A: Delete the whole regression suite and rebuild it from scratch
o.B: Report each failing test as a defect against the new code
o.C: Review the affected tests, update them to the new expected behavior and retire any that have become obsolete
o.D: Exclude the failing tests from the continuous integration run permanently

items.exEn: Because features change over iterations, test cases must evolve with them: revise outdated tests and retire obsolete ones.
items.qAr: في الـ iteration السادسة غيّر الـ product owner قاعدة خصم كانت قد نُفّذت في الـ iteration الثانية. بعد برمجة التغيير فشلت عدة automated regression tests لأنها ما زالت تتحقق من القاعدة القديمة. ماذا يجب على المختبِر أن يفعل أولاً؟
items.exAr: لأن الـ features تتغير عبر الـ iterations يجب أن تتطور الـ test cases معها، فتُحدَّث الاختبارات القديمة ويُستبعد ما أصبح غير صالح.

items.q: Why should testers allocate time in each iteration to review manual and automated test cases from previous and current iterations?

o.A: To select candidates for the regression test suite and to retire test cases that are no longer relevant
o.B: To re-estimate the story points of completed stories
o.C: To produce a detailed test plan document for the release
o.D: To decide which developers should fix which defects

items.exEn: Regularly reviewing tests keeps the regression suite relevant: suitable tests are added and obsolete ones are retired.
items.qAr: لماذا يجب على المختبِرين تخصيص وقت في كل iteration لمراجعة الـ test cases اليدوية والمؤتمتة من الـ iterations السابقة والحالية؟
items.exAr: المراجعة الدورية تُبقي الـ regression suite ملائمة: تُضاف الاختبارات المناسبة وتُستبعد الاختبارات غير الصالحة.

items.q: What is the main purpose of automated build verification tests in an Agile team?

o.A: To replace acceptance testing by the product owner
o.B: To quickly confirm after each new build that the software is stable and testable, giving fast feedback to the team
o.C: To measure the velocity of the team
o.D: To execute all exploratory testing sessions automatically

items.exEn: Build verification tests run on every new build to detect broken builds early and give immediate feedback before further testing.
items.qAr: ما الغرض الرئيسي من الـ automated build verification tests في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: تُشغَّل الـ build verification tests مع كل build جديد لاكتشاف الـ builds المعطوبة مبكراً وإعطاء feedback سريع قبل مزيد من الاختبار.

items.q: A team's automated unit tests run in 4 minutes, while its automated acceptance test suite takes 3 hours. How should these suites MOST appropriately be integrated into continuous integration?

o.A: Run both suites only at the end of the iteration
o.B: Run only the acceptance suite, because it covers the unit tests
o.C: Run both suites on every code check-in, regardless of duration
o.D: Run the unit tests on every check-in and the acceptance suite regularly, at least daily, on a full system build

items.exEn: Fast unit tests give feedback on each check-in; longer acceptance tests run regularly (e.g. nightly) as part of a full system build.
items.qAr: تستغرق الـ automated unit tests لدى فريق 4 دقائق، بينما تستغرق الـ automated acceptance test suite ثلاث ساعات. ما الطريقة الأنسب لدمجهما في الـ continuous integration؟
items.exAr: الـ unit tests السريعة تعطي feedback مع كل check-in، والـ acceptance tests الأطول تُشغَّل بانتظام (مثلاً كل ليلة) على build كامل للنظام.

items.q: The nightly automated regression run fails because of a real defect introduced by one of yesterday's check-ins. What should the team do?

o.A: Ignore the failure until the next iteration retrospective
o.B: Disable the failing tests so that the build turns green
o.C: Fix the underlying defect promptly, in time for the next code check-in
o.D: Log the defect and leave it for the release testing phase

items.exEn: Failing automated tests must be addressed quickly; the team fixes the underlying defect before continuing to build on broken code.
items.qAr: فشل تشغيل الـ automated regression الليلي بسبب defect حقيقي أدخله أحد الـ check-ins بالأمس. ماذا يجب أن يفعل الفريق؟
items.exAr: يجب التعامل مع الاختبارات المؤتمتة الفاشلة بسرعة، فيُصلح الفريق الـ defect قبل أن يستمر البناء فوق كود معطوب.

items.q: Besides test execution, which task can be automated to reduce testing effort in an Agile project?

o.A: Deploying builds into test environments and restoring a test environment to a baseline
o.B: Deciding on the business priority of user stories
o.C: Facilitating the iteration retrospective
o.D: Negotiating the scope of the release with the customer

items.exEn: Test data generation and loading, deploying builds, restoring environments to a baseline and comparing outputs are all candidates for automation.
items.qAr: إلى جانب تنفيذ الاختبارات، أي مهمة يمكن أتمتتها لتقليل جهد الاختبار في مشروع Agile؟
items.exAr: توليد الـ test data وتحميلها ونشر الـ builds وإعادة البيئة إلى baseline ومقارنة المخرجات كلها مهام قابلة للأتمتة.

items.q: Why is it beneficial to automate the installation and deployment of each new build into the test environment?

o.A: It removes the need for regression testing
o.B: It guarantees that no defects reach production
o.C: It allows the product owner to skip the iteration review
o.D: It ensures builds are installed quickly and consistently, so testing can start early and installation problems are found immediately

items.exEn: Automated deployment makes each build available to test quickly and repeatably, and exposes installation/deployment issues early.
items.qAr: لماذا من المفيد أتمتة تثبيت ونشر كل build جديد في بيئة الاختبار؟
items.exAr: أتمتة النشر تجعل كل build متاحاً للاختبار بسرعة وبطريقة متكررة ثابتة، وتكشف مشاكل التثبيت والنشر مبكراً.

items.q: A team works across two locations and uses an electronic task board tool instead of a physical board. What is the main advantage for communicating test status?

o.A: It makes the daily stand-up unnecessary
o.B: Test and development task status is visible to all members at all locations and can feed burndown charts automatically
o.C: It allows testing tasks to be hidden until the iteration ends
o.D: It means the tester no longer needs to update task status

items.exEn: Electronic task boards share status across locations and can generate burndown charts automatically, supporting transparency.
items.qAr: يعمل فريق في موقعين مختلفين ويستخدم أداة task board إلكترونية بدلاً من لوحة فعلية. ما الميزة الرئيسية لذلك في إيصال حالة الاختبار؟
items.exAr: الـ task board الإلكتروني يجعل حالة المهام مرئية للجميع في كل المواقع ويمكنه توليد الـ burndown charts تلقائياً.

items.q: Instead of waiting for a written specification, a tester in an Agile team goes directly to the product owner and business analyst to clarify how a new refund feature should behave. Which Agile tester skill does this BEST demonstrate?

o.A: Planning and organizing their own work
o.B: Being positive and solution-oriented
o.C: Actively acquiring information from stakeholders rather than relying entirely on written specifications
o.D: Accurately evaluating and reporting test results

items.exEn: Agile testers actively acquire information from stakeholders instead of relying only on written documentation.
items.qAr: بدلاً من انتظار مواصفات مكتوبة، يتوجه مختبِر في فريق Agile مباشرةً إلى الـ product owner والـ business analyst لتوضيح كيف يجب أن تعمل ميزة استرداد مبلغ جديدة. أي مهارة من مهارات المختبِر في Agile يُظهرها هذا بشكل أفضل؟
items.exAr: المختبِر في Agile يسعى بنفسه للحصول على المعلومات من المعنيين بدل الاعتماد الكامل على الوثائق المكتوبة.

items.q: In the middle of an iteration, the product owner refines the acceptance criteria of a story. The tester immediately adjusts existing test cases and adds new ones for the changed behavior. Which Agile tester skill does this illustrate?

o.A: Responding to change quickly, including changing, adding or improving test cases
o.B: Critical, skeptical thinking about the product
o.C: Working independently of the development team
o.D: Performing white-box testing

items.exEn: Agile testers respond quickly to change, which includes changing, adding or improving test cases.
items.qAr: في منتصف الـ iteration يحسّن الـ product owner الـ acceptance criteria لإحدى الـ stories، فيعدّل المختبِر فوراً الـ test cases الموجودة ويضيف أخرى جديدة للسلوك المتغير. أي مهارة من مهارات المختبِر في Agile يوضحها ذلك؟
items.exAr: المختبِر في Agile يستجيب للتغيير بسرعة، ومن ذلك تعديل الـ test cases وإضافتها وتحسينها.

items.q: In addition to good interpersonal skills, which set of technical skills is an Agile tester expected to have?

o.A: Database administration, network design and server configuration
o.B: Project budgeting, contract negotiation and resource allocation
o.C: User interface graphic design and branding
o.D: Test automation, test-driven development, acceptance test-driven development, and white-box, black-box and experience-based testing

items.exEn: Agile testers need competence in test automation, TDD, ATDD, and white-box, black-box and experience-based testing.
items.qAr: إلى جانب المهارات الشخصية الجيدة، ما مجموعة المهارات التقنية المتوقعة من المختبِر في Agile؟
items.exAr: يحتاج المختبِر في Agile إلى إتقان test automation وTDD وATDD والاختبار بأسلوب white-box وblack-box والاختبار القائم على الخبرة.

items.q: Which of the following is part of the tester's role in an Agile team?

o.A: Prioritizing the product backlog on behalf of the customer
o.B: Measuring and reporting test coverage across all applicable coverage dimensions
o.C: Assigning development tasks to individual developers
o.D: Acting as the sole gatekeeper who approves or rejects the release

items.exEn: The tester's role includes measuring and reporting coverage; backlog prioritization belongs to the product owner and the team is self-organizing.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ جزءاً من دور المختبِر في فريق Agile؟
items.exAr: من دور المختبِر قياس التغطية والإبلاغ عنها، أما ترتيب أولويات الـ backlog فهو للـ product owner، والفريق ينظم نفسه بنفسه.

items.q: How does a tester typically contribute to the iteration retrospective?

o.A: By presenting only the list of open defects
o.B: By attending only when testing problems occurred during the iteration
o.C: By actively suggesting and implementing improvements, especially to testing and quality practices
o.D: By evaluating the individual performance of each developer

items.exEn: Testers are full participants in retrospectives and propose and implement improvements, particularly regarding testing and quality.
items.qAr: كيف يساهم المختبِر عادةً في الـ iteration retrospective؟
items.exAr: المختبِر مشارك كامل في الـ retrospective، يقترح التحسينات وينفذها، خاصةً ما يتعلق بالاختبار والجودة.

items.q: After a year embedded in the same Agile team, a tester starts changing expected results in test cases to match whatever the code does whenever a developer says 'it works as designed', and no longer raises concerns about stories accepted with incomplete testing. Which organizational risk does this illustrate?

o.A: The tester losing the appropriate tester mindset and becoming tolerant of or silent about low-quality practices
o.B: The tester being unable to keep pace with incoming changes
o.C: The tester being overloaded with test automation work
o.D: The team lacking a definition of ready

items.exEn: Working very closely with developers can make testers lose independence: they adopt the developers' view and stay silent about poor practices.
items.qAr: بعد سنة من العمل ضمن نفس فريق Agile بدأ مختبِر يغيّر النتائج المتوقعة في الـ test cases لتطابق ما يفعله الكود كلما قال مطوّر 'it works as designed'، ولم يعد يعترض على قبول stories باختبار غير مكتمل. أي خطر تنظيمي يوضحه ذلك؟
items.exAr: العمل الوثيق جداً مع المطورين قد يُفقد المختبِر استقلاليته، فيتبنى وجهة نظرهم ويسكت عن الممارسات الضعيفة.

items.q: In a team working in one-week iterations, developers deliver several changed stories to the single tester every day. The tester cannot finish testing them before new changes arrive. Which organizational risk does this describe?

o.A: The tester losing independence from the developers
o.B: The tester becoming too skeptical of the product
o.C: The product owner refusing to accept stories
o.D: The tester being unable to keep pace with the incoming changes in time-constrained iterations

items.exEn: A recognized risk is that testers cannot keep up with the volume of changes in short, time-boxed iterations.
items.qAr: في فريق يعمل بـ iterations مدتها أسبوع واحد يُسلّم المطورون يومياً عدة stories معدّلة إلى المختبِر الوحيد، ولا يستطيع إنهاء اختبارها قبل وصول تغييرات جديدة. أي خطر تنظيمي يصفه ذلك؟
items.exAr: من المخاطر المعروفة عجز المختبِرين عن مجاراة حجم التغييرات في الـ iterations القصيرة المحددة زمنياً.

items.q: Which action would BEST mitigate the risk of a tester being overwhelmed by the volume of work in short iterations?

o.A: Postponing all testing to a dedicated hardening iteration at the end of the release
o.B: Applying the whole-team approach, with developers sharing testing tasks, more regression tests automated and test effort included in iteration planning
o.C: Asking the tester to work overtime every iteration
o.D: Reducing testing to unit tests only

items.exEn: Sharing testing work across the team, automating regression tests and planning test effort keep testing sustainable.
items.qAr: أي إجراء يخفف بشكل أفضل خطر أن يُثقَل المختبِر بحجم العمل في الـ iterations القصيرة؟
items.exAr: توزيع مهام الاختبار على الفريق كله وأتمتة الـ regression tests وإدراج جهد الاختبار في الـ iteration planning تجعل الاختبار مستداماً.

items.q: A new story requires a test environment with specific configuration and realistic test data. According to the tester's role in an Agile team, who typically takes responsibility for configuring, using and managing this test environment and test data?

o.A: The product owner
o.B: The Scrum master
o.C: The tester, in collaboration with the rest of the team
o.D: An external operations team only, after the iteration ends

items.exEn: Configuring, using and managing test environments and test data is part of the tester's role, done collaboratively within the team.
items.qAr: تتطلب story جديدة بيئة اختبار بإعدادات محددة وtest data واقعية. وفقاً لدور المختبِر في فريق Agile، من يتولى عادةً إعداد هذه البيئة والـ test data واستخدامها وإدارتها؟
items.exAr: إعداد بيئات الاختبار والـ test data واستخدامها وإدارتها جزء من دور المختبِر، ويتم بالتعاون مع بقية الفريق.

items.q: Which of the following is a benefit of test-driven development (TDD) as described in the Agile Tester syllabus?

o.A: It helps developers focus on clearly defined expected results, and the resulting tests are automated and used in continuous integration
o.B: It removes the need for testers to perform system-level and acceptance testing
o.C: It ensures that business representatives write all unit tests before coding starts
o.D: It replaces refactoring, because the code is written correctly the first time

items.exEn: TDD helps developers focus on clearly defined expected results; its tests are automated and run in continuous integration.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ فائدةً من فوائد الـ test-driven development (TDD) كما يصفها منهج الـ Agile Tester؟
items.exAr: يساعد الـ TDD المطوّرين على التركيز على نتائج متوقعة محددة بوضوح، والاختبارات الناتجة مؤتمتة وتُشغَّل ضمن الـ continuous integration.

items.q: In TDD, why is the newly written test run before the production code for it is written?

o.A: To measure the performance of the existing code base
o.B: To confirm that the test fails, showing that it checks functionality that does not exist yet
o.C: To allow the product owner to approve the test before implementation
o.D: To generate test data for the integration tests

items.exEn: The new test should fail at first because the code it checks has not been written yet; this shows the test is meaningful.
items.qAr: في الـ TDD، لماذا يُشغَّل الاختبار الجديد قبل كتابة الكود الإنتاجي الخاص به؟
items.exAr: يجب أن يفشل الاختبار الجديد في البداية لأن الكود الذي يتحقق منه لم يُكتب بعد، وهذا يُثبت أن الاختبار ذو معنى.

items.q: Which statement describes a typical benefit of the tests created through acceptance test-driven development (ATDD)?

o.A: They are written only after the iteration ends and are therefore based on the final code
o.B: They are low-level unit tests that focus on the internal structure of the code
o.C: They are reusable for regression testing and can be executed by tools, often within continuous integration
o.D: They are informal notes that are discarded once the story is accepted

items.exEn: ATDD creates reusable tests for regression testing; specific tools support creating and running them, often in CI.
items.qAr: أي عبارة تصف فائدةً نموذجيةً للاختبارات التي تُنشأ عبر الـ acceptance test-driven development (ATDD)؟
items.exAr: ينتج الـ ATDD اختبارات قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام في الـ regression testing، وتدعم أدوات محددة إنشاءها وتشغيلها، غالباً ضمن الـ CI.

items.q: Before a story is developed, the product owner, a developer and a tester meet to agree on examples of how the story must behave, and these examples become the acceptance tests. Which approach is the team using?

o.A: Test-driven development (TDD)
o.B: Session-based exploratory testing
o.C: Static analysis
o.D: Acceptance test-driven development (ATDD)

items.exEn: ATDD defines acceptance criteria and tests collaboratively, with business, development and testing, while the user story is being created.
items.qAr: قبل تطوير قصة ما، يجتمع الـ product owner ومطوّر وفاحص للاتفاق على أمثلة توضح كيف يجب أن تتصرف القصة، وتصبح هذه الأمثلة اختبارات القبول. أي منهجية يتّبعها الفريق؟
items.exAr: يحدد الـ ATDD معايير القبول والاختبارات بشكل تعاوني بين ممثلي الأعمال والتطوير والاختبار أثناء إنشاء الـ user story.

items.q: Why are tests written with behaviour-driven development (BDD) generally easier for business stakeholders to understand?

o.A: Because they are based on the exhibited behaviour of the software rather than on its internal code
o.B: Because they are always executed manually through the user interface
o.C: Because they contain the full source code of the feature
o.D: Because they are written only by the product owner

items.exEn: BDD tests are based on the behaviour the software exhibits, which makes them easier for other team members and stakeholders to understand.
items.qAr: لماذا تكون الاختبارات المكتوبة باستخدام الـ behaviour-driven development (BDD) أسهل فهماً عادةً لأصحاب المصلحة من جهة الأعمال؟
items.exAr: تعتمد اختبارات الـ BDD على السلوك الظاهر للبرمجية، وهذا ما يجعلها أسهل فهماً لبقية أعضاء الفريق ولأصحاب المصلحة.

items.q:
Consider the BDD scenario:
Given a registered user with an empty cart
When the user adds a book priced 20 JOD to the cart
Then the cart total shows 20 JOD
What does the "When" line represent?

o.A: The precondition or initial context of the scenario
o.B: The action or event that triggers the behaviour being tested
o.C: The expected outcome that must be verified
o.D: The test data cleanup performed after the test

items.exEn: In Given/When/Then, Given sets the context, When describes the triggering action or event, and Then states the expected outcome.
items.qAr: بالسيناريو اللي فوق (بصيغة Given/When/Then)، ماذا يمثّل سطر الـ "When"؟
items.exAr: في صيغة Given/When/Then: الـ Given يحدد السياق، والـ When يصف الإجراء أو الحدث المُحفِّز، والـ Then يحدد النتيجة المتوقعة.

items.q: What is the main difference between TDD and BDD?

o.A: TDD is used only in sequential lifecycles, while BDD is used only in Agile projects
o.B: TDD tests are written after the code, while BDD tests are written before the code
o.C: TDD is primarily code-focused at unit level, while BDD focuses on the expected behaviour of the software, often expressed in a Given/When/Then format
o.D: TDD is performed by testers only, while BDD is performed by developers only

items.exEn: TDD tests are mainly unit-level and code-focused; BDD focuses on expected behaviour and frameworks often use Given/When/Then.
items.qAr: ما الفرق الرئيسي بين الـ TDD والـ BDD؟
items.exAr: اختبارات الـ TDD غالباً على مستوى الـ unit وتركّز على الكود، بينما يركّز الـ BDD على السلوك المتوقع للبرمجية وغالباً بصيغة Given/When/Then.

items.q: According to the test pyramid, how are tests at the system and acceptance levels typically automated?

o.A: Using API-based tools only
o.B: Using static analysis tools
o.C: Using unit testing frameworks run by the compiler
o.D: Using GUI-based tools

items.exEn: In the test pyramid, unit and integration tests are automated with API-based tools, while system and acceptance tests use GUI-based tools.
items.qAr: وفقاً للـ test pyramid، كيف تُؤتمت عادةً الاختبارات على مستويي النظام والقبول؟
items.exAr: في الـ test pyramid تُؤتمت اختبارات الـ unit والـ integration بأدوات تعتمد على الـ API، بينما تستخدم اختبارات النظام والقبول أدوات تعتمد على الـ GUI.

items.q: Which testing principle is the test pyramid concept based on?

o.A: Exhaustive testing is impossible
o.B: Early QA and testing, eliminating defects as early as possible in the lifecycle
o.C: Testing shows the absence of defects
o.D: Defects are distributed evenly across all modules

items.exEn: The pyramid relies on the principle of early QA and testing: finding defects at lower levels as early as possible.
items.qAr: على أي مبدأ من مبادئ الاختبار يعتمد مفهوم الـ test pyramid؟
items.exAr: يعتمد الـ test pyramid على مبدأ الاختبار وضمان الجودة المبكرين، أي إزالة الـ defects في أبكر وقت ممكن من دورة الحياة.

items.q: To which kind of testing do the Agile testing quadrants apply?

o.A: Dynamic testing rather than static testing
o.B: Static testing rather than dynamic testing
o.C: Only regression testing at the end of a release
o.D: Only testing performed by the product owner

items.exEn: The CTFL-AT syllabus states that the testing quadrants apply to dynamic testing rather than static testing.
items.qAr: على أي نوع من الاختبار تنطبق الـ Agile testing quadrants؟
items.exAr: ينص منهج CTFL-AT على أن الـ testing quadrants تنطبق على الاختبار الديناميكي وليس على الاختبار الساكن.

items.q: A team builds a clickable prototype and a simulation of a new workflow so that business stakeholders can confirm the requirements before development. In which testing quadrant do these activities belong?

o.A: Q1
o.B: Q3
o.C: Q2
o.D: Q4

items.exEn: Q2 is business-facing and supports the team; it includes functional tests, examples, story tests, user experience prototypes and simulations.
items.qAr: يبني فريقٌ prototype قابلاً للنقر وsimulation لسير عمل جديد كي يؤكد أصحاب المصلحة من جهة الأعمال المتطلبات قبل التطوير. إلى أي quadrant تنتمي هذه الأنشطة؟
items.exAr: الـ Q2 موجّه للأعمال ويدعم الفريق، ويشمل الاختبارات الوظيفية والأمثلة والـ story tests والـ prototypes والـ simulations.

items.q: Which statement correctly describes how tests in the different quadrants are typically executed?

o.A: Q1 tests are usually manual, while Q4 tests are usually exploratory
o.B: Q2 tests must always be manual, while Q3 tests must always be automated
o.C: All quadrants should be fully automated and run in continuous integration
o.D: Q1 tests are often automated and included in CI, Q3 tests are often manual and user-oriented, and Q4 tests are often automated

items.exEn: Per CTFL-AT: Q1 often automated in CI; Q2 manual or automated; Q3 often manual and user-oriented; Q4 often automated.
items.qAr: أي عبارة تصف بشكل صحيح الطريقة التي تُنفَّذ بها عادةً الاختبارات في الـ quadrants المختلفة؟
items.exAr: وفق CTFL-AT: الـ Q1 غالباً مؤتمت ضمن الـ CI، والـ Q2 يدوي أو مؤتمت، والـ Q3 غالباً يدوي وموجّه للمستخدم، والـ Q4 غالباً مؤتمت.

items.q: A company invites a group of selected customers to use a new release at their own sites and report their experience before general availability. Why does this activity belong to Q3?

o.A: Because it is technology-facing and supports the developers while they write code
o.B: Because it is business-facing and critiques the product from the user's point of view
o.C: Because it is technology-facing and checks non-functional characteristics such as load
o.D: Because it is business-facing and is used to define acceptance criteria before coding

items.exEn: Beta testing evaluates the product from a business/user perspective after it is built, so it is business-facing and critiques the product (Q3).
items.qAr: تدعو شركةٌ مجموعةً من العملاء المختارين لاستخدام إصدار جديد في مواقعهم والإبلاغ عن تجربتهم قبل الإطلاق العام. لماذا ينتمي هذا النشاط إلى الـ Q3؟
items.exAr: الـ beta testing يقيّم المنتج من منظور الأعمال والمستخدم بعد بنائه، لذا فهو موجّه للأعمال وينقد المنتج (Q3).

items.q: During an iteration, which sequence do user stories typically progress through in terms of test levels, according to the Agile Tester syllabus?

o.A: Unit testing, then feature acceptance testing, with regression testing running in parallel
o.B: Acceptance testing, then unit testing, then system testing
o.C: System integration testing, then unit testing, with no regression testing until the release
o.D: Only acceptance testing, because unit testing is optional in Agile

items.exEn: Within an iteration a story typically goes through unit testing, then feature acceptance testing (verification and validation), with regression testing in parallel.
items.qAr: وفقاً لمنهج الـ Agile Tester، ما التسلسل الذي تمرّ به الـ user stories عادةً من حيث مستويات الاختبار خلال الـ iteration؟
items.exAr: خلال الـ iteration تمر القصة عادةً بالـ unit testing ثم الـ feature acceptance testing (التحقق والمصادقة)، مع تنفيذ الـ regression testing بالتوازي.

items.q: Which of the following is an activity in which a tester typically collaborates with the team during Sprint Zero?

o.A: Executing the final user acceptance test of the release
o.B: Fixing the defects found in the previous release
o.C: Creating an initial test strategy for all test levels and performing an initial quality risk analysis
o.D: Writing the unit tests for every story in the product backlog

items.exEn: In Sprint Zero the tester helps identify scope, set up tools, create the initial test strategy, perform initial quality risk analysis, define metrics and the definition of done.
items.qAr: أي مما يلي يُعدّ نشاطاً يتعاون فيه الفاحص عادةً مع الفريق خلال الـ Sprint Zero؟
items.exAr: في الـ Sprint Zero يساعد الفاحص في تحديد النطاق وتجهيز الأدوات وإنشاء الـ test strategy الأولية وإجراء تحليل أولي لمخاطر الجودة وتحديد المقاييس والـ definition of done.

items.q: In an Agile team, the progress of both development and testing is always visible to everyone on the task board. Which team best practice does this reflect?

o.A: Co-located
o.B: Resilient
o.C: Empowered
o.D: Transparent

items.exEn: The syllabus defines 'Transparent' as development and testing progress being visible on the Agile task board.
items.qAr: في فريق Agile، يكون تقدّم التطوير والاختبار مرئياً دائماً للجميع على الـ task board. أي ممارسة من ممارسات الفريق الجيدة يعكس ذلك؟
items.exAr: يعرّف المنهج صفة الـ Transparent بأنها ظهور تقدّم التطوير والاختبار على الـ Agile task board.

items.q: A tester builds test cases from a user story by starting with simple tests and gradually moving to more complex ones as the story is refined. Which Agile testing practice is this?

o.A: Incremental test design
o.B: Pairing
o.C: Mind mapping
o.D: Test-first refactoring

items.exEn: Incremental test design means test cases and charters are built from user stories, starting with simple tests and moving toward more complex ones.
items.qAr: يبني فاحصٌ الـ test cases من user story بدءاً باختبارات بسيطة والانتقال تدريجياً إلى اختبارات أكثر تعقيداً مع تحسين القصة. أي ممارسة اختبار Agile هذه؟
items.exAr: الـ incremental test design يعني بناء الـ test cases والـ charters من الـ user stories بدءاً بالاختبارات البسيطة وصولاً إلى الأكثر تعقيداً.

items.q: Which statement best describes the role of a tester in a Scrum team according to the Agile Tester syllabus?

o.A: The tester belongs to an independent test department and receives builds only at the end of each sprint
o.B: The tester is a member of the cross-functional team who collaborates continuously with developers and business representatives throughout the iteration
o.C: The tester is responsible alone for the quality of the product and approves each release
o.D: The tester acts as the Scrum Master and removes impediments for the team

items.exEn: Teamwork is fundamental: the tester is part of the cross-functional, self-organizing team and works closely with developers and business representatives.
items.qAr: أي عبارة تصف دور الفاحص في فريق Scrum بأفضل شكل وفقاً لمنهج الـ Agile Tester؟
items.exAr: العمل الجماعي مبدأ أساسي: الفاحص جزء من الفريق متعدد الوظائف وذاتي التنظيم، ويعمل بشكل وثيق مع المطوّرين وممثلي الأعمال.

items.q:
A team lists the following tests for an online booking system:
1. An automated test checking the price calculation function
2. A usability session with real users booking a pitch
3. An automated story test based on the product owner's examples
4. A test restoring the system after a database server failure
Which mapping to the testing quadrants is correct?
items.exEn: Unit/component test = Q1; usability = Q3; story tests from examples = Q2; recovery testing = Q4.
items.qAr: يُدرج فريقٌ الاختبارات اللي فوق لنظام حجز إلكتروني. أي ربط بالـ testing quadrants صحيح؟
items.exAr: اختبار الـ unit/component هو Q1، والـ usability هو Q3، والـ story tests المبنية على الأمثلة هي Q2، والـ recovery testing هو Q4.

items.q: Which of the following tests belongs to a DIFFERENT testing quadrant from the other three?

o.A: An exploratory test session on the checkout flow
o.B: An alpha test performed by internal staff
o.C: A compatibility test of the web app on several browsers
o.D: A scenario test walking through a complete customer journey

items.exEn: Exploratory, alpha and scenario tests are Q3; compatibility testing is technology-facing and critiques the product (Q4).
items.qAr: أي من الاختبارات التالية ينتمي إلى quadrant مختلف عن الثلاثة الأخرى؟
items.exAr: الـ exploratory والـ alpha والـ scenario tests تنتمي إلى الـ Q3، أما الـ compatibility testing فهو موجّه للتقنية وينقد المنتج (Q4).

items.q: A team's automated suite contains 30 unit tests, 50 API-level integration tests and 450 end-to-end tests through the GUI. The suite is slow and many GUI tests break after small layout changes. Based on the test pyramid, what is the most appropriate improvement?

o.A: Add more GUI tests so that every screen is covered twice
o.B: Remove the unit tests because the GUI tests already cover the same logic
o.C: Run the GUI tests manually instead of automating them
o.D: Move most of the checks down to unit and API-level tests and keep a smaller number of GUI tests

items.exEn: The pyramid recommends many fast, low-level tests and fewer high-level GUI tests; this suite is an inverted pyramid.
items.qAr: تحتوي مجموعة الاختبارات المؤتمتة لفريقٍ ما على 30 unit test و50 integration test على مستوى الـ API و450 اختبار end-to-end عبر الـ GUI. المجموعة بطيئة، وكثير من اختبارات الـ GUI تتعطل بعد تغييرات بسيطة في التصميم. استناداً إلى الـ test pyramid، ما التحسين الأنسب؟
items.exAr: يوصي الـ test pyramid بعدد كبير من الاختبارات السريعة منخفضة المستوى وعدد أقل من اختبارات الـ GUI عالية المستوى؛ وهذه المجموعة تمثّل هرماً مقلوباً.

items.q: A tester must classify the following test: "Run 2,000 simulated concurrent users for one hour and check that the server's memory usage stays stable." In which testing quadrant does this test belong?

o.A: Q4 - technology-facing, critiques the product
o.B: Q1 - technology-facing, supports the team
o.C: Q2 - business-facing, supports the team
o.D: Q3 - business-facing, critiques the product

items.exEn: Load and memory management testing are technology-facing tests that critique the product, which is Q4.
items.qAr: على الفاحص أن يصنّف الاختبار التالي: "تشغيل 2,000 مستخدم متزامن افتراضياً لمدة ساعة والتحقق من أن استهلاك الذاكرة على الخادم يبقى مستقراً." إلى أي quadrant ينتمي هذا الاختبار؟
items.exAr: اختبار الحِمل وإدارة الذاكرة اختبارات موجّهة للتقنية وتنقد المنتج، أي أنها في الـ Q4.

items.q:
A team rates each user story for likelihood and impact on a scale from 1 (low) to 5 (high) and calculates the risk level as likelihood × impact.
S1: likelihood 4, impact 2
S2: likelihood 3, impact 5
S3: likelihood 5, impact 2
S4: likelihood 2, impact 4
Which story should receive the most extensive testing?

o.A: S1
o.B: S2
o.C: S3
o.D: S4

items.exEn: S2 = 3×5 = 15 is the highest risk level (S1 = 8, S3 = 10, S4 = 8).
items.qAr:
يقيّم فريق كل user story من حيث الاحتمالية (likelihood) والأثر (impact) على مقياس من 1 (منخفض) إلى 5 (مرتفع)، ويحسب مستوى الخطر على أنه likelihood × impact.
S1: likelihood 4، impact 2
S2: likelihood 3، impact 5
S3: likelihood 5، impact 2
S4: likelihood 2، impact 4
ما الـ story التي يجب أن تحظى بأوسع اختبار؟
items.exAr: مستوى خطر S2 = 3×5 = 15 وهو الأعلى (S1 = 8، S3 = 10، S4 = 8).

items.q:
During quality risk analysis, four features are rated (likelihood, impact) on a 1–5 scale, and risk level = likelihood × impact.
F1: (2, 5)
F2: (4, 4)
F3: (3, 2)
F4: (5, 3)
In which order, from highest to lowest risk, should the features be tested?
items.exEn: F2 = 16, F4 = 15, F1 = 10, F3 = 6, so the order is F2, F4, F1, F3.
items.qAr:
أثناء تحليل مخاطر الجودة (quality risk analysis) تم تقييم أربع features بالقيمتين (likelihood, impact) على مقياس 1–5، ومستوى الخطر = likelihood × impact.
F1: (2, 5)
F2: (4, 4)
F3: (3, 2)
F4: (5, 3)
بأي ترتيب، من الأعلى خطراً إلى الأدنى، يجب اختبار الـ features؟
items.exAr: F2 = 16، F4 = 15، F1 = 10، F3 = 6، لذا الترتيب هو F2, F4, F1, F3.

items.q:
A team uses risk level = likelihood × impact (each 1–5) to decide test depth: 12 or more → extensive, 6 to 11 → moderate, 5 or less → light.
Story X: likelihood 2, impact 3
Story Y: likelihood 4, impact 3
Story Z: likelihood 1, impact 5
Which test depth assignment is correct?

o.A: X moderate, Y extensive, Z light
o.B: X light, Y extensive, Z moderate
o.C: X moderate, Y moderate, Z extensive
o.D: X light, Y moderate, Z light

items.exEn: X = 6 (moderate), Y = 12 (extensive), Z = 5 (light).
items.qAr:
يستخدم فريق مستوى الخطر = likelihood × impact (كل منهما 1–5) لتحديد عمق الاختبار: 12 فأكثر → مكثّف، من 6 إلى 11 → متوسط، 5 فأقل → خفيف.
Story X: likelihood 2، impact 3
Story Y: likelihood 4، impact 3
Story Z: likelihood 1، impact 5
أي توزيع لعمق الاختبار صحيح؟
items.exAr: X = 6 (متوسط)، Y = 12 (مكثّف)، Z = 5 (خفيف).

items.q:
A team rates likelihood and impact from 1 (low) to 3 (high); risk level = likelihood × impact. In this iteration there is only time to test two stories extensively.
Change password: likelihood 2, impact 3
Change avatar: likelihood 3, impact 1
Fingerprint login: likelihood 3, impact 3
Display tips: likelihood 1, impact 1
Which two stories should be tested extensively?

o.A: Fingerprint login and Change avatar
o.B: Change avatar and Change password
o.C: Change password and Display tips
o.D: Fingerprint login and Change password

items.exEn: Fingerprint login = 9 and Change password = 6 are the two highest (Change avatar = 3, Display tips = 1).
items.qAr:
يقيّم فريق الـ likelihood والـ impact من 1 (منخفض) إلى 3 (مرتفع)، ومستوى الخطر = likelihood × impact. في هذه الـ iteration يوجد وقت لاختبار two stories فقط بشكل مكثّف.
Change password: likelihood 2، impact 3
Change avatar: likelihood 3، impact 1
Fingerprint login: likelihood 3، impact 3
Display tips: likelihood 1، impact 1
أي two stories يجب اختبارهما بشكل مكثّف؟
items.exAr: Fingerprint login = 9 وChange password = 6 هما الأعلى (Change avatar = 3، Display tips = 1).

items.q:
For a banking story, two quality risks are identified, using low = 1, medium = 2, high = 3 and risk level = likelihood × impact.
Risk 1: interest is calculated incorrectly (likelihood medium, impact high)
Risk 2: a label is misaligned on the screen (likelihood high, impact low)
Which statement is correct?

o.A: Risk 2 should get more test effort because its likelihood is higher
o.B: Both risks should get equal test effort because each has one high rating
o.C: Risk 1 should get more test effort because its risk level (6) is higher than that of risk 2 (3)
o.D: Neither risk needs testing until defects are reported by users

items.exEn: Risk 1 = 2×3 = 6 and risk 2 = 3×1 = 3, so risk 1 deserves more test effort.
items.qAr: في story بنكية تم تحديد خطرين للجودة، باستخدام منخفض = 1، متوسط = 2، مرتفع = 3، ومستوى الخطر = likelihood × impact. الخطر 1: حساب الفائدة بشكل خاطئ (likelihood متوسطة، impact مرتفع). الخطر 2: label غير محاذٍ على الشاشة (likelihood مرتفعة، impact منخفض). أي عبارة صحيحة؟
items.exAr: الخطر 1 = 2×3 = 6 والخطر 2 = 3×1 = 3، لذا يستحق الخطر 1 جهد اختبار أكبر.

items.q: In the first round of planning poker for a story, four team members show the cards 3, 5, 5 and 21. What should happen next?

o.A: The members who showed 3 and 21 explain their reasoning, the team discusses, and a new round of estimation is played
o.B: The average (8.5) is calculated and rounded to 8 as the final estimate
o.C: The value 5 is taken as the final estimate because most members chose it
o.D: The product owner selects the final estimate from the cards shown

items.exEn: When estimates diverge widely, the highest and lowest estimators explain, the team discusses, and estimates again until consensus.
items.qAr: في الجولة الأولى من planning poker لإحدى الـ stories، أظهر أربعة أعضاء البطاقات 3 و5 و5 و21. ماذا يجب أن يحدث بعد ذلك؟
items.exAr: عندما تتباعد التقديرات كثيراً، يشرح صاحبا التقدير الأعلى والأدنى أسبابهما، ثم يتناقش الفريق ويعيد التقدير حتى الوصول إلى توافق.

items.q: A team's velocity over the last three iterations was 18, 22 and 20 story points, and it plans with the average. The prioritized backlog contains stories of 8, 5, 3, 5 and 8 points, in that order. If stories are taken strictly in priority order and planning stops at the first story that does not fit, how many stories are planned for the next iteration?
items.exEn: Average velocity = (18+22+20)/3 = 20; 8+5+3 = 16, and adding the next 5 gives 21 > 20, so 3 stories.
items.qAr: كانت الـ velocity لفريق في آخر ثلاث iterations هي 18 و22 و20 story points، ويخطط الفريق باستخدام المتوسط. يحتوي الـ backlog المرتب حسب الأولوية على stories بقيم 8 و5 و3 و5 و8 points بهذا الترتيب. إذا أُخذت الـ stories حسب الأولوية تماماً وتوقف التخطيط عند أول story لا تتسع، فكم story سيتم التخطيط لها في الـ iteration القادمة؟
items.exAr: متوسط الـ velocity = (18+22+20)/3 = 20؛ 8+5+3 = 16، وإضافة الـ 5 التالية تعطي 21 > 20، إذن 3 stories.

items.q: A team uses the planning poker scale 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21. After discussion, everyone agrees that a story is about 1.5 times the size of a reference story estimated at 5 points, and clearly smaller than a reference story estimated at 13 points. Which value should be assigned?
items.exEn: 1.5 × 5 = 7.5, which is not on the scale; the nearest card between 5 and 13 is 8.
items.qAr: يستخدم فريق مقياس planning poker التالي: 1، 2، 3، 5، 8، 13، 21. بعد النقاش اتفق الجميع على أن الـ story أكبر بحوالي 1.5 مرة من story مرجعية قُدّرت بـ 5 points، وأصغر بوضوح من story مرجعية قُدّرت بـ 13 points. ما القيمة التي يجب إعطاؤها؟
items.exAr: 1.5 × 5 = 7.5 وهي غير موجودة على المقياس؛ أقرب بطاقة بين 5 و13 هي 8.

items.q: In the last iteration, a team completed stories of 8, 5, 3 and 8 points that met the definition of done. A further 6-point story was developed, but its testing was not finished. What is the team's velocity for that iteration?
items.exEn: Only stories that are done count: 8+5+3+8 = 24; the untested 6-point story is not counted.
items.qAr: في آخر iteration أنجز فريق stories بقيم 8 و5 و3 و8 points حققت الـ definition of done. وتم تطوير story إضافية بقيمة 6 points لكن اختبارها لم يكتمل. ما هي الـ velocity للفريق في تلك الـ iteration؟
items.exAr: تُحتسب فقط الـ stories المنجزة (done): 8+5+3+8 = 24؛ ولا تُحتسب الـ story ذات الـ 6 points غير المختبرة.

items.q: The remaining release backlog is estimated at 130 story points and the team's stable velocity is 25 points per iteration. How many iterations are needed to complete the release backlog?
items.exEn: 130 / 25 = 5.2, which rounds up to 6 iterations because a partial iteration is still needed.
items.qAr: يُقدَّر الـ release backlog المتبقي بـ 130 story points، والـ velocity المستقرة للفريق هي 25 points لكل iteration. كم iteration نحتاج لإنجاز الـ release backlog؟
items.exAr: 130 / 25 = 5.2، وتُقرَّب إلى الأعلى لتصبح 6 iterations لأن الجزء المتبقي يحتاج iteration إضافية.

items.q: Two stories need similar development effort. Story X changes the tax calculation used by four existing reports, so it has a high quality risk and needs extensive regression testing. Story Y only changes the text of a label. What is the most appropriate result of whole-team estimation?

o.A: Both stories get the same estimate because their development effort is the same
o.B: Story X gets a higher story point estimate than story Y, because the estimate includes the testing effort driven by its higher risk
o.C: Both stories get the same estimate and the extra testing for story X is tracked outside the story points
o.D: Story Y gets a higher estimate because UI changes are harder to automate

items.exEn: In the whole-team approach, story points include testing effort, which grows with the quality risk.
items.qAr: تحتاج two stories جهد تطوير متقارب. الـ story X تغيّر حساب الضريبة المستخدم في أربعة reports موجودة، لذا لديها quality risk مرتفع وتحتاج regression testing مكثّف. أما الـ story Y فتغيّر نص label فقط. ما النتيجة الأنسب لتقدير الفريق كاملاً (whole-team estimation)؟
items.exAr: في الـ whole-team approach تشمل الـ story points جهد الاختبار، والذي يزداد بازدياد الـ quality risk.

items.q:
User story: "As a customer, I want to apply a discount code at checkout so that I pay less."
Acceptance criteria:
1. A valid code reduces the order total by 10%.
2. An expired code shows the message "Code expired" and the total is unchanged.
3. Only one code can be applied per order.
Which acceptance test is correctly derived from these criteria?

o.A: Given a cart total of 200 JOD and a valid code, when the customer applies the code, then the total becomes 190 JOD
o.B: Verify that checkout responds correctly with 1,000 concurrent users
o.C: Given a cart total of 200 JOD and an expired code, when the customer applies the code, then the total becomes 180 JOD
o.D: Given a cart total of 200 JOD and a valid code, when the customer applies the code, then the total becomes 180 JOD

items.exEn: Criterion 1: 10% off 200 JOD gives 180 JOD; the other options have wrong results or are not based on the criteria.
items.qAr:
الـ user story: «بصفتي عميلاً، أريد تطبيق كود خصم عند الدفع لكي أدفع أقل».
الـ acceptance criteria:
1. الكود الصالح يخفّض إجمالي الطلب بنسبة 10%.
2. الكود المنتهي يُظهر الرسالة "Code expired" ويبقى الإجمالي دون تغيير.
3. يمكن تطبيق كود واحد فقط لكل طلب.
أي acceptance test مشتق بشكل صحيح من هذه المعايير؟
items.exAr: المعيار 1: خصم 10% من 200 JOD يعطي 180 JOD؛ أما الخيارات الأخرى فنتائجها خاطئة أو غير مبنية على المعايير.

items.q:
User story: password reset.
Acceptance criteria:
AC1: A reset link is sent to the registered email address.
AC2: The link expires after 24 hours.
AC3: The new password must be different from the current password.
Existing tests:
T1: Request a reset for a registered email and verify the link is received.
T2: Use the link after 25 hours and verify it is rejected.
Which test should be added to cover the acceptance criteria?

o.A: Enter the current password as the new password and verify it is rejected
o.B: Request a reset for a registered email and verify the link arrives in the inbox
o.C: Use the link after 26 hours and verify it is rejected
o.D: Verify that the reset page loads in less than one second

items.exEn: T1 covers AC1 and T2 covers AC2; AC3 has no test yet.
items.qAr:
الـ user story: إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور (password reset).
الـ acceptance criteria:
AC1: يُرسل رابط إعادة التعيين إلى البريد الإلكتروني المسجّل.
AC2: تنتهي صلاحية الرابط بعد 24 ساعة.
AC3: يجب أن تختلف كلمة المرور الجديدة عن كلمة المرور الحالية.
الـ tests الموجودة:
T1: طلب إعادة تعيين لبريد مسجّل والتحقق من وصول الرابط.
T2: استخدام الرابط بعد 25 ساعة والتحقق من رفضه.
أي test يجب إضافته لتغطية الـ acceptance criteria؟
items.exAr: الـ T1 يغطي AC1 والـ T2 يغطي AC2؛ أما AC3 فليس له test بعد.

items.q: Acceptance criterion: "After three consecutive failed login attempts, the account is locked." Which Given/When/Then scenario correctly expresses this criterion?

o.A: Given the account is locked, when the user enters a wrong password three times, then the user has three failed attempts
o.B: Given a user has two consecutive failed login attempts, when the user enters a wrong password again, then the account is locked
o.C: Given the user enters a wrong password, when the account is locked, then three attempts have failed
